Received a phone call from a homeowner stating she saw a cougar on her property the evening of 10-05-17. Officers contacted the citizen who states her daughter saw the cougar on 10-06-2017. Officers provided advice.

DFW Officers were notified of a cougar that had been killed by a vehicle.  DFW Officer retrieved the carcass, verified it had a broken leg and appeared to have been hit by a car, and obtained the tooth sample before disposal of the carcass.
Caller saw a cougar sitting on the porch of an abandoned property. Officers contacted the caller who stated it was actually his mother who saw the animal out of her rearview mirror. Unconfirmed.
Caller advised that a cougar was killing his chickens. Officers called and provided advice.

CITIZEN CALLED BECAUSE SHE SAW A COUGAR ON WEDNESDAY NIGHT AND THEN LAST NIGHT IT WAS ON THEIR ROOF, JUMPED DOWN AND POSSIBLY GOT THE RACCOON THAT WAS EATING THE CAT FOOD AND THEN WAS ON THEIR BACK DECK. OFFICERS PROVIDED ADVICE.

CALL FROM THE MANAGER OF AN HOA ASSOCIATION STATING A COUGAR WAS SIGHTED ON ONE OF THE PROPERTIES THEY MANAGE. HOA MANAGER WAS TOLD BY A HOMEOWNER THAT ON THE EVENING OF 09/26/2017 A COUGAR WALKED ACROSS HER BACK DECK AND INTO THE NEIGHBOR'S YARD.

Landowner reported having four sheep harvested in the last ten days by a possible cougar.  DFW Officer responded and talked to reporting party and neighbors.  Hound hunter was used to attempt to locate a cougar but was unable to find the cougar.

DFW Officer received a report of a cougar being in an area for the last two weeks.  Officer contacted landowner and provided advice on removing anything that may attract cougars to the property.  The cougar had only walked through the property.
DFW Officer responded to report of two goats being harvested by a cougar.  The carcasses were examined and determined to be from a cougar.  Advice was provided to the reporting party.

DFW Officer received a report of fresh cougar tracks.  DFW Officer contacted the reporting party and informed them there were no hound hunters available to attempt to locate the cougar.  Advice was provided.

DFW Officers were contacted reference a sheep that was possibly harvested by a cougar.  DFW Officers responded and after examining the carcass determined the wounds were consistent with a cougar.  Advice on living in cougar territory was provided.
CALLER OBSERVED A COUGAR IN THE AREA. HE WAS PROVIDED ADVICE BY LOCAL OFFICERS.
CALLER REPORTED A COUGAR SIGHTING BY HIS DAUGHTER. SHE WAS OUT ON A WALK WHEN THEY CROSSED THE ROADWAY. CALLER WAS PROVIDED ADVICE.
DFW Officer was notified of a cougar.  Officer contacted the reporting party who described what the Officer believed was a cougar.  DFW Officer provided advice on cougar behavior.

DFW Officer responded to a report of a cow possible harvested by a cougar.  The cow carcass had injuries consistent with that of a cougar.  The landowner did not want DFW to use a hound hunter to attempt to locate the cougar due to hunting season.

Caller stated her husband took their dog out the night before. They heard it yelping and when they returns found the dog wounded. Officers looked at images provided and believed it to be coyote not cougar but were unable to confirm as so much time had passed between the attack and when it was reported.

Caller stated she was with her three children in the park behind the dog walking area. She saw a tan colored animal that was approx. 30 pounds.. Officers called the citizen and were unable to confirm it was a cougar.

Report through SCSO dispatch.  DFW Officer responded to five goats being harvested in a field.  Four sheep showed no physical signs on injury and the fifth had wounds indicative of a cougar.  Advice was given.

Caller reported seeing a cougar on the fence between her apartment building and the nearby school.  It was giving her small dog a hard look while being barked at.  During the conversation she accurately described seeing a bobcat.  She was given advise and thanked for the information.

DFW Officer responded to a report of a landowner having a goat harvested by a cougar during the night.  The goat carcass was buried and the owner had one photo of what appeared to be the tail of a cougar.  Dog was used but could not locate a cougar.

DFW Officer was notified of a sheep that was possibly harvested by a cougar.  Landowner was given authorization and advised to hunt over the carcass in the event the cougar returned.  During the night the cougar returned but was not harvested.

A cougar was seen at night by a neighbor prior to three young goats being missing from the homeowner.  There were no signs of the goats or any evidence as to what may have taken or happened to the goats.
Citizen called and stated she has observed a small cougar on her property twice in the last two days. Advice was provided

DFW Officer was notified of a cougar that had been shot by homeowner while it was killing the homeowners chickens.  Officer arrived and spoke with homeowner who had previously lost chickens and was waiting to see if the cat returned.

DFW Officers received a report of a cougar that was attempting to get some chickens.  The cougar was shot at but ran off.  The owner has a license and tag for a cougar and was attempting to track down the cougar.
Caller advised there was a cougar sighting near her property. Conflict staff called and she advised it had been in her driveway. They set trail cameras but after two days of no activity pulled them.

Caller reported finding tracks on his property. He stated when contacted by officers that a neighbor had one of their dogs attacked and another had a sheep killed. Officers were unable to confirm this based on the prints found.

Homeowner reporting a cougar sighting on her property at 7:30 am the morning of 10/26/2017. Officers responded and the callers grandson is who saw the cougar. It ran away when it saw him. Advice was provided.
Caller advised they found fresh cougar tracks. Officers called but were unable to track the cat due the time period. Officers provided advice.

DFW Officers received a report of two cougars entering a pen that housed goats, chickens, and dogs.  A few days later the cougars returned and one goat was attacked. A houndsman was used but could not locate the cougars.
Caller reported that while driving a school bus she saw  a large cougar cross the roadway. Neighbors had reported seeing one in the area as well. Officers provided advice.

Caller reported that he thought a cougar was getting into a neighbor's yard to get his chickens. Officers responded and checked the area where it was confirmed that nothing had been bothered by a cougar. The neighbor owned a rabbit that made holes under the fence which was mistaken for cougar activity.

Caller advised he had lost two calves on his property to what he believed was a cougar. A conflict specialist went to the property and after looking at both carcasses confirmed they were not killed by a cougar.

DFW responded to a report of a sheep possibly killed by a cougar.  The landowner had two other sheep lost over the last two years.  A camera was set up over carcass and a cougar returned.  Hound hunter was unable to locate the cougar.

DFW Officers were notified of cougar images being taken on the reporting party's trail cameras.  Another neighbor also had footage of cougars in the area.  DFW Officers planned to attempt to haze the cougar from the area.

DFW Officers received a report of possibly three cougars, one adult and two cubs, that have been seen on Carol Lane.  Reporting party has images from a camera of cougars.  Reporting party said he will contact DFW if he sees the cougars again.
Caller advised to report a cougar that was near his residence. There had not been any recent sightings. This was unconfirmed.

Caller advised that he saw a cougar near his bus stop and didn't feel comfortable going to school. Officers contacted him back and found that he was 12 years old. They were able to speak with his mother who confirmed he did NOT see a cougar.

Caller advised that a cougar had been possibly chasing a dog at his residence and the cougar was then killed by the property owner. She looked into the tree and told me she could see an adult cougar with two kittens. Caller explained that she took one shot to try and scare them away and when they did not leave, she stated she tried to shoot one. She advised she wasn't sure if she hit one or not and went back inside because she was out of ammunition. Caller found and dispatched the cougar.

Area wildlife manager was contacted reference cougar tracks that were seen near calving pens.  A neighbor reported seeing a cougar exiting the pens in recent days.  DFW Officer confirmed the cougar tracks.
DFW Officer received a report of a cougar coming onto reporting party property.
Caller reported a cougar seen on her rental property. They state they saw a cougar in a tree. Officers weren't able to confirm.
DFW Officer responded to a report of a goat being harvested by a predator.  The goat had wounds consistent with those made by a feline.  It was undetermined if it was a cougar or a bobcat.
Caller reported he had three mules in his pasture when he heard a cougar scream.. He found what he thought were cougar tracks . Advice was provided.
Caller advised of a cougar on her neighbor's property. She hadn't seen the cougar but her husband did.

DFW Officers received a report of two small dogs being taken from the back deck.  The landowners followed a blood trail and saw a quick glimpse of a gray animal running away from the dog carcasses.  A hound hunter was used but could not locate a cat.
Caller reported a cougar behind her house. This was unconfirmed.
Caller stated a deer was killed near the horse arena. There were no drag marks found so officers thought it was likely coyote or dog.
Caller reported cougar sighting crossing the road.

Caller advised of an injured cougar under his evergreen tree. Officers arrived on scene and located the cougar who was unable to move when approached. They lethally removed the cougar as it was not able to get up.

DFW Officers received a report of a cougar that ran within two feet of a husband and wife, surprising them from behind because their dogs weren't barking. The adult cougar was being chased by his two dogs and ran into the woods.
Home owner reported a dead deer on her property she thought may have been shot.  DFW Officer arrived and determined the deer had been taken by a cougar.
Caller reported cougar captured on their trail camera. Officers provided advice.
Citizen reported to state patrol about seeing a post on Facebook regarding a cougar in the area.

DFW Officers received a report of a cougar at a homeowners residence at night.  Officer met with homeowner who said the cougar was seen at night and circled the garage before leaving.  Information on cougars and avoiding conflict was provided.
Citizen reported to state patrol sighting a cougar that jumped out of a tree and ran through the neighborhood. WSP investigated but were unable to locate any sign of a cougar.

DFW Officer received report of a possible depredation of two sheep by a cougar.  Officer responded and this occurred near the same location of depredations in past years.  A cougar was trapped in past years.  A trap was set using the carcass.
Citizen reported her horse being attacked by a possible cougar. WDFW investigated and found the horse was actually scratched by a fence.

WDFW Officer received a report of a goat being killed by a cougar.  Officer responded and the wounds were not consistent with a cougar.  A hunter with a valid tag did harvest a cougar near the property shortly after.

DFW Officers received a report of four sheep harvested by a cougar.  Officers responded and viewed the carcasses.  They found paw prints that appeared to be from a cougar.  A trap was used in an attempt to trap the cougar if it returned.
Citizen reported a possible cougar near their trailer sighted on different occasions. WDFW is unable to confirm the sighting at this time.
Citizen reported a possible cougar staying near their property. WDFW provided advice.
DFW Officers were notified that the homeowners report there has been a cougar on the property for the last two days.  The report came from a family member on behalf of the homeowner.
Citizen reported secondhand information of a possible cougar in the area. WDFW provided advice.
DFW Officers were notified of a cougar that was seen in the reporting party driveway.  The cougar ran off.  Reporting party just wanted to notify DFW as they have no pets or live stock.

DFW Officer received a call about a cougar that had been in a yard for a day.  Officer arrived and was able to see the cougar circle the chicken coop before running off.  Homeowner was advised to purchase a cougar tag.

DFW Officers were notified of a report of a cougar eating an animal in a roadway.  Officer responded and was unable to locate a cougar.  When the reporting party was contacted, they showed Officer where they saw the cougar.

DFW Officers were notified of a cow that had been harvested by a wild animal.  Upon inspection of the animal the wounds were consistent with that of being from a cougar.  A trap was set in an attempt to trap the cougar if it returned.

DFW Officers received a report of a cow that had been found dead.  Officers examined the cow and the injuries were consistent with that being from a cougar.  A trap was used but did not catch a cougar.  The landowner was given advice on cougars.
Citizen reported a possible cougar sighting. WDFW is unable to confirm the sighting at this time.
Citizen reported a possible cougar sighting in the area. WDFW investigated and found no signs of cougars but provided advice.

DFW Officers were notified of a possible depredation of a goat by a cougar.  No carcass was found but tufts of hair and pieces were found.  The landowner saw a paw print of a cougar which was not able to be located when Officers arrived.
Citizen reported sighting a cougar near his property. WDFW is unable to confirm the sighting at this time and provided advice.
Citizen reported a possible cougar sighting in his neighborhood. WDFW provided advice.

DFW Officers received a report of a cougar that was laying in the yard 45 feet from the homeowners house.  The homeowner walks to her neighbors and did not feel safe doing so.  Conflict specialist provided information on living in cougar country.

Land owner reported a pony that had been harvested by a cougar.  DFW Officer responded, confirmed the carcass appeared to be taken by a cougar.  A houndsman was used and the dogs treed a cougar which was dispatched.
Citizen reported sighting a possible cougar running across the road the night prior. WDFW investigated and contacted the citizen. WDFW is unable to confirm the sighting at this time.
Citizen reported that her horses were acting strange the night before and is suspicious of a cougar being in the area. WDFW provided advice.
Home owner found what she believed was scat from a cougar in her yard.  Another neighbor told her there was a cougar in the area and to be careful.  Safety considerations and advice was provided.

Land owner reported a motion camera had taken video of a cougar next to his garage.  The cougar has not done anything as of the time of the report.  Land owner asked about protecting his property, DFW Officer provided advice and information.

Citizen reported a large predator killing two sheep and a ram on their property the night prior. WDFW investigated and believed the depredation was likely from a cougar. A houndsman was called out and a cougar was unable to be located, likely due to fresh snow falling. WDFW set up a carcass under a camera to see if the cougar would come back to feed. 3 days later, there was still no sign of a cougar returning.

one sub adult cougar sleeping in the road (within Pomeroy city limits)  RP said the cougar ran toward a residents and the Pomeroy Golf Course.

CITIZEN REPORTED THAT A COUGAR HAS BEEN ROAMING HER AND A NEIGHBOR'S PROPERTY FOR THE LAST 48 HOURS. CITIZEN WAS MOST CONCERNED BECAUSE THE COUGAR DIDN'T SHOW ANY FEAR OF HUMANS.
CITIZEN CALLED STATING A COUGAR CROSSED THE ROADWAY. CITIZEN JUST WANTED IT REPORTED.
CITIZEN REPORTED A COUGAR THAT TRIED ON TWO ATTEMPTS TO GET INTO HER CHICKEN COOP. AN OFFICER CONTACTED HER AND PROVIDED ADVICE ON BETTER SECURING HER LIVESTOCK.

FAW. rcvd. report of cougar sighting. RP showed a picture to the Officer of a cougar walking into the timber. FAW Officer provided info/advice on living with cougars/livestock & protecting property. Trail camera photo showed 1 collared cougar nearby.

CITIZEN CALLED STATING ONE OF HER COWS WAS FOUND DECEASED WITH BITE MARKS TO ITS NECK. OFFICERS MET WITH THE CITIZEN AND OBSERVED COYOTE TRACKS AROUND THE CARCASS. OFFICERS SET UP A GAME CAMERA IN AN ATTEMPT TO CAPTURE WHICH ANIMAL WAS INVOLVED.
CITIZEN REPORTED A COUGAR THAT WAS ON THE PROPERTY. IT LEFT THE AREA AFTER THE CITIZEN YELLED AT IT.

FAW rcvd. report of 2 young cougars trying to break into cat cages outside. The RP fired a few rounds & scared them off. This was the 3rd time the RP had seen them. FAW provided info/advice on living with cougars & protecting the property.
FAW rcvd. a report of a cougar sighting caught on a game camera in the evening. FAW provided cougar brochures & info/advice.

CITIZEN CALLED TO REPORT A GOAT OF HIS THAT WAS KILLED IN HIS PASTURE. OFFICERS RESPONDED AND DUE TO PUNCTURE MARKS ON THE NECK AND THE LOCATION OF THE CARCASS BELIEVE IT WAS A COUGAR THAT WAS THE CULPRIT.
CITIZEN CALLED REGARDING A COUGAR SEEN IN HIS AREA.
CITIZEN CALLED STATING HE SAW A COUGAR IN HIS YARD. OFFICER CONTACTED THE CITIZEN AND PROVIDED ADVICE.
CITIZEN REPORTS SOMEONE SAW A COUGAR NEAR THEIR PROPERTY. CITIZEN STATED HE LIVED NEAR A SCHOOL. OFFICERS CALLED THE CITIZEN AND LOCAL SCHOOL. OFFICERS RESPONDED TO THE AREA AND FOUND NO COUGAR.
CITIZEN CALLED REF TWO COUGARS IN HIS YARD. CITIZEN REPORTED THEM MAKING A LOT OF NOISE AS WELL. OFFICERS RESPONDED AND FOUND A RACCOON IN THE TREE MAKING NOISE BUT OBSERVED NO OTHER ACTIVITY.
FAW rcvd. report of a cougar attempting to get into a chicken coop. FAW provided info/advice on living with cougars & owning livestock. Advised to call again if the cougar was spotted.

FAW rcvd. several reports of a cougar sighted over the course of 7 weeks within the same general area. It was first reported sighted on June 11th walking near a ditch line. It did not show any aggression according to the RP's. The same cougar was recently reported on July 12th. It was sighted at 19:15 hours behind a residents home. FAW believes it is a female cougar based off of the descriptions. FAW provided advice/info to the RP's about living with cougars.
FAW rspd. to a poss. cougar depredation on 2 goats. They had been disemboweled. FAW Officer with K9 & Conflict Specialist rspd. to the area. They were UTL the cougar.
CITIZEN REPORTED A DOE DEER KILLED IN HER DRIVEWAY BY A COUGAR. A CONFLICT SPECIALIST CONTACTED THE CITIZEN AND PROVIDED ADVICE.
CITIZEN REPORTS A COUGAR SHE SAW IN THE WOODS NEAR THE PLAYGROUND IN DEER FIELD/SPORTS FIELD PARK. CITIZEN REPORTS IT SAW THEM AND WALKED INTO THE WOODS.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on a goat. The goats were tied to graze overnight when one was taken. Trail cameras were set & Houndsmen were called out. 1 adult female cougar was captured on camera. Houndsmen treed & FAW euthanized the adult female cougar. Samples were taken.
CITIZEN CALLED REGARDING HEARING WHAT HE THOUGHT WAS A COUGAR POSSIBLY KILLING SOMETHING IN HIS NEIGHBOR'S WOODED YARD. AN OFFICER CONTACTED HIM AND PROVIDED SAFETY INFORMATION.
CITIZEN CALLED TO REPORT A COUGAR THAT RAN ACROSS THE ROADWAY.

FAW rcvd. report of issues with a cougar taking their livestock. The cougar had been spotted twice within a few weeks by the landowners. Houndsmen were sent out & unable to locate cougar tracks. A game camera was set & the RP was designated to check the camera feed.
Property owner reported seeing a cougar in their backyard. DFW officer provided advice and education.

CITIZEN REPORTED HE AND HIS CHILDREN WERE PLAYING OUTSIDE. THEIR DOGS ACTED STRANGELY AND NOISE WAS HEARD IN THE BUSHES. THE CITIZEN HAD SEEN A COUGAR ON THE PROPERTY TWO DAYS PRIOR TO THIS INSTANCE. GENERAL ADVICE WAS PROVIDED BY OFFICERS AS THE CITIZEN HAD MANY SPOTS OF DENSE VEGETATION THAT A COUGAR COULD HIDE IN.
CITIZEN REPORTED SEEING A COUGAR WALK ACROSS HIS NEIGHBOR'S YARD. AN OFFICER CONTACTED THE CITIZEN AND PROVIDED GENERAL ADVICE.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a sheep. The RP had experience cougar issues in the past. The sheep carcass had been moved by the cougar from the previous night. Examination showed the kill pattern consistent with a cougar. Poss. cougar tracks were located in the area. Houndsmen were called out, & located 1 cougar a short distance away. It was treed & euthanized. Samples were taken from the cougar.
FAW rcvd. a report of a cougar sighting on HWY 97. RP had previously seen 2 young cougars days before on their property. FAW Officer gave advice/ info on living with cougars.
Property owner reported a possible cougar sighting in his backyard. DFW officer provided advice and education.

CITIZEN CALLED TO REPORT A COUGAR SIGHTING. CITIZEN AND A FRIEND WERE SITTING ON HER BACK DECK WHEN THEY SAY A SMALL COUGAR WALKED ON THE DECK. CITIZEN REPORTED IT AS VERY YOUNG AND TWO FEET TALL. ONCE THE COUGAR SPOTTED THEM IT RAN AWAY.

CITIZEN REPORTS A COUGAR SIGHTING 1 MILE FROM HER RESIDENCE. CITIZEN REPORTED THAT HER DOG, CAT AND CHICKENS HAD GONE MISSING THE SAME WEEK. OFFICERS CONTACTED THE CITIZEN WHO ADVISED THERE WERE TO MANY PREDATORS TO DETERMINE WHAT HAD TAKEN HER DOMESTIC PETS AND PROVIDED ADVICE.

FAW rcvd. a report of a cougar depredation on a sheep. Evidence at the scene determined there was a small cougar in the area, too young to be on its own. One young male cougar was trapped & euthanized. There was no evidence of a second cougar.

FAW rcvd. a report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. The goat was left freely out in the pasture & was found partially buried the next day. Examination of the carcass confirmed a cougar depredation. FAW Officer & the RP discussed it would be best to remove, secure & clean up the attractants. The carcass was removed & a trail camera was set. Houndsmen were sent out the next morning to attempt to haze the cougar away from the property. 1 adult female cougar was euthanized & removed.
CITIZEN REPORTS A COUGAR SIGHTING NEAR THE BASEBALL FIELDS. OFFICERS TRIED TO CALL THE CITIZEN BACK BUT WERE UNABLE TO REACH HIM TO CONFIRM WHAT HE SAW.
CITIZEN REPORTED COUGAR SIGHTING ON THE PROPERTY. AN OFFICER CALLED THE CITIZEN BACK TO PROVIDE INFORMATION.
FAW rcvd. report of sighting a female cougar with 2 offspring. The RP fired several rounds to scare them off. FAW gave advice/info & advised the RP to report any future incidents or sightings.
FAW rcvd. a report of a cougar sighting in a trailer park area west of the Cashmere Valley Bank. The cougar walked into the bushes when it was spotted. FAW gave advice & information.

CITIZEN CALLED TO REPORT A SHEEP KILLED IN HIS PASTURE. OFFICERS SET UP A CAMERA ON THE PROPERTY NEAR THE CARCASS AND CONTACTED HOUNDSMEN. ON 6/18 A COUGAR WAS CAUGHT ON CAMERA. THAT SAME DAY HOUNDS WERE USED TO TRACK THE COUGAR WHICH WAS EUTHANIZED BY AN OFFICER.
CITIZEN CALLED TO REPORT A COUGAR SHE HAD SEEN NEAR A NEIGHBOR'S RESIDENCE. OFFICERS CONTACTED THE CITIZEN AND PROVIDED GENERAL ADVICE.

FAW responded to a report of a cougar depredation on 2 sheep. 1 carcass showed a small amount of blood on the neck but wasn't moved. The 2nd carcass was drug & consumed. No tracks were located. Few teeth marks were visible & the feeding pattern determined it was a cougar kill. 1 depredation permit was issued.
CITIZEN REPORTED A COUGAR SIGHTING AT HER RESIDENCE ON 6/17
CITIZEN REPORTS A GOAT KILLED IN HIS PASTURE. OFFICERS RESPONDED AND VERIFIED IT WAS COYOTES.

FAW rcvd. a report of a cougar in a tree playing with quail in a vineyard. FAW Officer responded & was UTL a cougar on the property. RP provided a picture of a cougar kitten, with spots & approx.. 30lbs. FAW gave advice/info & advised to report if there was anymore sightings in the area.
FAW responded to a poss. cougar depredation on a calf. The carcass was located & a trail camera was placed over the carcass. Trail camera confirmed it was a cougar.

FAW rcvd. a report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. FAW Officer & Conflict Specialist inspected the goat carcass & determined it was a cougar kill. A game camera was set & Houndsmen were sent out. Houndsmen were unable to locate the cougar & the game camera did not capture any photos of a cougar. The carcass was removed & disposed of.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on 2 goats. FAW arrived @ the scene & examined the pen & carcasses. The feeding pattern determined it was a cougar kill. 1 Cougar Depredation Permit was issued with designated Houndsmen.
CITIZEN REPORTED HITTING A COUGAR WITH HIS VEHICLE AS IT CROSSED THE ROAD IN FRONT OF HIS VEHICLE. BIOLOGISTS CHECKED THE AREA BUT WERE UNABLE TO LOCATE ANY INJURED OR DECEASED COUGARS.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on 2 goats. Conflict Specialist determined the sign at the property was a cougar. 1 carcass was removed by the cougar while FAW was ENRT. to the location. FAW Karelian Bear Dog arrived. Due to poor weather & time delay the goat carcass nor the cougar was located.

FAW rcvd. a report of a poss. cougar depredation on a chicken. The cougar jumped the fence & took 1 chicken out of the area. RP did not want the cougar to be euthanized or for FAW to respond. RP informed FAW they would secure their coop & work on their fencing. FAW provided advice/ information on cougars & fencing suggestions.
CITIZEN REPORTS A COUGAR THAT RAN ACROSS THE ROAD IN FRONT OF THEIR VEHICLE. IT APPEARED TO THE CITIZEN TO BE A CUB.
CITIZEN REPORTED SEEING A COUGAR AT THE KEISER PERMANENTE BUILDING ON HIS NIGHTLY DELIVERIES. CITIZEN REPORTED TWO SIGHTINGS
CITIZEN CALLED TO REPORT A COUGAR SIGHTING IN THE VISCINITY OF THE SCHOOL.

FAW rcvd. a report of a poss. cougar depredation on a sheep. RP advised that the previous Friday they had 12 sheep killed. FAW & Houndsmen responded. The RP had drug the sheep carcass remains from the area where it was found. Small cougar tracks were located near the creek bed. Hounds located a small cougar nearby. 1 young female cougar was removed, DNA samples taken. Camera was set on carcass remains. A 2nd cougar appeared on camera 3 days later.
FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting on a porch. The cougar proceeded to head west of the property. FAW provided advice/ information & asked the RP to let neighbors in the area know.

FAW rcvd. report of  a bicyclist observing a cougar a short distance away from the road. The person yelled @ the cougar & continued riding the bike. After continuing riding, the cougar continued to walk that same direction. FAW Officer gave advice/ info & provided a can of bear spray.
CITIZEN CALLED TO ADVISE OF A COUGAR IN TOWN. CITIZEN STATED A NEIGHBOR CLAIMED TO HAVE A TRAIL CAMERA PICTURE OF THE COUGAR.

CITIZEN REPORTED A COUGAR CONFRONTATION WITH A DOG. OFFICERS CALL THE CITIZEN WHO ADVISED THE NEIGHBOR'S DOG WAS BARKING- A LOUD FIGHT WAS THEN HEAR. AN ASSUMPTION WAS MADE THAT THE ANIMAL IN CONFLICT WAS A COUGAR HOWEVER WHEN CITIZEN WENT OUTSIDE THE DOG APPEARED FINE AND LIKELY HAD FOUGHT WITH RACCOONS.
FAW rcvd. report of someone shooting at a cougar twice. The RP was unsure if they hit the cougar or not. FAW Officers responded  with Houndsmen & removed the cougar from the area.
FAW rcvd. report of a cougar in a yard for approx. 30 minutes. RP yelled @ it & shot at it with a BB gun. FAW gave advice/ info & advised to call back if necessary.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting caught on a game camera. 1 collared cougar was on the RP's property over several days. The sighting was within the last week previous to the report. Advice/information was provided.
CITIZEN REPORTED A COUGAR WHO HAD JUST KILLED A RABBIT. HE REPORTED THE COUGAR TO BE VERY THIN. A CONFLICT SPECIALIST CONTACTED THE CITIZEN AND PROVIDED ADVICE.

CITIZEN REPORTED SCRATCHES ON THEIR HORSES FACE AND SIDE THAT THEY BELIEVED WERE FROM A COUGAR. AN OFFICER RESPONDED TO THE RESIDENCE AND AFTER INSPECTING THE HORSE DETERMINED THE SCRATCHES WERE NOT FROM A COUGAR.

CITIZEN ORIGINALLY REPORTS SCRATCH MARKS FOUND ON HER HORSE. EARLY IN THE MORNING SHE HEARD LOUD NOISES AND FOUND ONE OF HER GOATS MISSING. AN OFFICER WAS ENROUTE WHEN THE CITIZEN CALLED BACK STATING THEY FOUND THE GOAT. THE CITIZEN SENT IMAGES OF THE SCRATCH WOUNDS TO THE OFFICER WHO VERIFIED THEY WERE NOT FROM A COUGAR.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting & a dog missing. The RP saw a cougar above his house that jumped out of a tree shortly after their dog went missing & there was cougar sign in the area. FAW informed the RP they could not confirm if the dog was missing or deceased because of the cougar that was sighted. FAW Officer walked the property with the RP & provided advice/info on living with cougars & how to protect the property.
CITIZEN REPORTED FAWNS OR DEER TAKEN DOWN (KILLED) BY THE RIVER. CITIZEN HAD SEEN WHAT HE THOUGHT WAS A COUGAR TRACK IN THE AREA BUT HAD NEVER SEEN THE ANIMAL.

FAW  rcvd. a report of a depredation on a Ram in a pasture. RP reported hearing commotion the night before. FAW responded  & examined the carcass, determining it was a cougar kill.  Houndsmen were called out & treed one cougar. The cougar was dispatched & determined an adult male, approx. 6- 8 years. The cougar was removed from the scene, DNA samples were taken & the head was sent to the Kalispel Tribe for research purposes.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting & a deer depredation in the area. RP expressed concern for an event on the property near Lacamas Creek. FAW Conflict Specialist provided advice/ info on living with cougars & advised to report future sightings.

FAW rcvd. that there had been a cougar in a yard near a barn 3 weeks ago. RP heard the dog barking outside & saw a cougar in the driveway moving towards the dog. The cougar ran away when RP scared it off. A permit was issued to Houndsmen for 2 weeks,

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar that had been near a barn 3 weeks ago, prior to the report. The AM of the report, the RP let the dog out & heard barking. A cougar was walking towards the dog & the RP was able to scare it off. A depredation permit was issued to a hound hunter for 2 weeks.

CITIZEN REPORTED A COUGAR SIGHTING. CITIZEN STATED SHE SAW IT IN THE EARLY MORNING OF JUNE 27TH. CITIZENS DOMESTIC CAT HAD GONE MISSING TWO TO THREE DAYS PRIOR AFTER HEARING A SCUFFLE. IT IS NOT CONFIRMED THAT A COUGAR WAS INVOLVED.

FAW rcvd. a report of a cougar sighting. RP's security footage showed a cougar walking across the residences driveway early in the morning. FAW Officer confirmed it was a cougar & provided advice/info on living with cougars.

CITIZEN REPORTED ONE OF THEIR COWS DECEASED ON THE PROPERTY. CITIZEN THOUGHT IT WAS A POSSIBLE COUGAR KILL. OFFICERS RESPONDED AND WERE UNABLE TO VERIFY IT WAS A COUGAR AS IT HAD NO PUNCTURE MARKS AND THERE WERE NO IMAGES CAPTURE ON THE CAMERA THAT HAD BEEN SET UP.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP described to the Officer what seemed to be a cougar, walking in the RP's back yard. The area has a healthy deer population according to the RP  & Officer. FAW checked the area & was UTL a cougar. FAW Officer provided advice/info on living with cougars & advised to report future sightings.

FAW rcvd. report of a horse poss. attacked by a cougar. FAW Officer spoke with the RP. A vet believed the injuries could've been from a cougar. FAW Officer & Bio rspd. the next day & looked at the horse. They were UTL a cougar or any sign. The puncture marks on the horse appeared to be too shallow & close together to be a cougar bite. FAW Officer & Bio determined it was not a cougar attack. FAW gave advice/info to RP.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in Colfax. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP heard something running through the woods behind the house @ night. A deer got up & started to run. The RP believe they heard a fawn get attacked by a cougar. The fawn cried for about 40 seconds & then stopped. The RP saw yellow eyes on top of the hill but wasn't sure what it was. FAW gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a sheep. FAW Officer rspd. with Houndsman. The property has had  unknown depredation issues in the past. FAW Officer was able to locate the sheep carcass, the intestines & stomach had been removed. Birds had been feeding on the carcass. No cougar sign was located by the Officer or Hounds. The puncture marks on the lamb & other signs appeared to be Coyotes. A game camera was set & a coyote was seen later that night. Info/advice was provided.

FAW rcvd. report of 2 cougars roaming on private property. 1 cougar was sighted by the neighbor. The cougar was on the patio & then ran into trees by the river after the car drove by it. FAW Officer did not locate tracks or cougar sign on the property. Another neighbor saw 2 cougars pass by the shed in the morning. FAW Officer issued a pursuit only permit for 1 cougar to designated Houndsmen.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The poss. cougar was climbing down a fallen tree. The RP believed it was younger as it was a darker brown & had a long tail. RP saw it from approx. 100 yards away.

FAW rcvd. report of poss. cougar scat @ a residences property. The RP informed the Officer upon arrival that there were other incidents involving cougars & livestock @ the properties nearby, but none had been reported. The Officer searched the area & located coyote scat & 1 unidentifiable scat pile. A trail camera was set on the logging rd on the property. FAW Officer gave advice/info on living with cougars.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP saw a cougar run across the property & wanted to let FAW know.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted & cougar scat in the area. RP just wanted to inform FAW.

CITIZEN REPORTED A SHEEP THAT WAS KILLED ON HER PROPERTY. OFFICERS RESPONDED BUT THE CARCASS HAD BEEN DISPOSED OF. GOING OFF OF IMAGES ONLY OFFICERS WERE UNABLE TO VERIFY WHETHER IT WAS COYOTE OR COUGAR KILL.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a sheep. FAW observed the sheep carcass drug approx. 50 yards from the pen area. FAW confirmed a cougar depredation. Houndsmen were called out & located one young male sub adult cougar. The cougar was dispatched, removed & a trail camera was set to determine if there was another cougar in the area.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on several goats that occurred a few weeks ago. There were also ducks & chickens missing. FAW Officers contacted the RP. The RP informed the Officer there were several weak spots in the fence & they would improve the fencing. The RP believe there were 2 different cougars in the area. RP only wanted to advise WDFW about the situation. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in a driveway. The cougar continued to walk away & did not show aggression. It was described as big as a large dog with a long tail. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting. The RP was sitting on the porch & observed the cougar walking through the horse pasture. The RP was able to yell & scare it off. FAW Officer contacted the RP. FAW Officer gave advice/info on living with cougars & livestock.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. Ocean Shores Animal Control Officer was UTL the cougar @ the location. Animal Control Officer worked with FAW Conflict Specialist. Info/advice was provided to RP on cougars.

FAW rcvd, report of a cougar sighting in someone's yard. RP yelled at it & shot at it with a BB gun. FAW Officer provided advice/info on living with cougars & advised to call & report future sightings or incidents.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar was sitting in the yard. A dog in the area had gone missing & another had returned with scratches. It was unknown if that was due to the cougar. FAW provided advice/info on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a sheep. The cougar drug the sheep from the pasture, under a hot wire fence when the RP was able to scare it off. The sheep had 2 punctures on the neck & a puncture on the hind quarters. The sheep was alive when the RP reported it to FAW. Houndsmen were called out. FAW Officer inspected the sheep & the area where it was drug. Houndsmen treed one female adult cougar & was dispatched by FAW. DNA samples were taken.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting involving 2 cougars. The RP saw one in a tree & the other by a gate @ the Cemetery. A Columbia CO. Sheriff checked the area but was UTL any cougar. FAW Officer attempted to contact the RP but rcvd. a full VM inbox.
FAW rcvd. a 3rd hand report of a cougar crossing the road in front of someone while walking a dog. It was described as large & in an area covered by woods & brush. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. child being followed by a cougar. The RP saw a social media post & reported it to FAW. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice information. There was no information to follow up with the child from the social media post.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar incident with a horse. The horses broke through the fence after being spooked & had several injuries. A neighbor had found a poss. cougar track the day before. The injuries were not consistent enough to be a cougar but still possible. The fencing was barbed wire, t-posts & other materials without caps. There were several hazards in the pasture. After searching the area there was no cougar sign. FAW Officer provided advice/info on living with cougars & livestock

FAW rcvd. report of poss. cougar eyes spotted. RP saw 3 cougar eyes when flashing a light outside. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The Officer was unable to confirm based on the info provided. FAW gave advice/info on living in cougar territory.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar was following a turkey. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP wanted to give for information only.
CITIZEN CALLED REF LIVESTOCK ON THEIR PROPERTY THAT THEY THOUGHT WAS KILLED BY A COUGAR. OFFICERS INVESTIGATED AND FOUND THE ANIMAL WAS LIKELY KILLED BY A COYOTE.

FAW rcvd. report of cougar sightings caught on a trail camera. The sightings were approx. 35 yards from the residence home. RP informed the Officer there has been no issues at this time. FAW Officer gave advice/info on living with cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on a dog. FAW Officers responded with Houndsmen. Hounds were unable to locate a scent. A trail camera was set. FAW advised RP & neighbors of cougar protocol & what to do if it was spotted again.

FAW rcvd. report of someone chasing a cougar out of a driveway. The cougar had been spotted twice within the week by the same RP. Over the last few years there had been complaints of cougars around the area. 1 pursuit only hound permit was issued to assigned Houndsmen.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on a deer in a yard. RP informed the Officer the cougar had been spotted several times but hadn't been reported by those who had seen it prior to him. FAW Officer provided advice/info on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar stalking a rooster in the AM. RP believed it was an adult male cougar. The RP had lost several chickens & believes the cougar was the reason. A Houndsman rspd. & treed a small tagged black bear. The Houndsman were going to check the area the next day for any other predators. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on 2 dogs 3 weeks prior to reporting it. RP's neighbor also found a deer head on their property. FAW Officer contacted the RP & advised there was a time delay & to report future sightings/incidents. The RP set up trail cameras & was provided advice/info on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting in a tree in a back yard. The RP feared it was going to go after the dog & took a shot at it. The cougar jumped down to the ground & took off. The RP believes she did not hit it. FAW Officer provided advice/info on living with cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar on the RP's porch stalking a domestic cat. The cougar then ran into the woods. FAW provided advice/info to the RP about living with cougars & advised to call the Officer if there were anymore sightings.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar had climbed a tree where there was deer nearby. FAW Officer & PTPD arrived on scene. No cougar was observed. A large raccoon & crows nest were in the tree upon arrival. FAW Officer gave advice/info.
FAW rcvd. report of 3 cougars captured on game camera footage. One cougar had a tracking collar on, the others did not.

FAW rcvd. a report of a cougar near a chicken coop. RP saw the cougar approx. 20 feet away & yelled at it. The cougar ran off & hasn't been seen again. FAW Officer provided advice/info on living with cougars & owning livestock.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar that had poss. attacked something. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP heard the cougar & something make noise. FAW Officer went to the scene. The Officer did not observe anything & showed the RP the dead pine needles made up a brown spot they were looking at. The noises that were described to the Officer, fit raccoons fighting. FAW Officer found no cougar evidence.
FAW rcvd. report of a  small cougar lying down in the grass. The RP believes other people had seen a few larger cougars in the area as well. FAW provided advice/info on living with cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on a house cat. Trail camera footage confirmed the depredation. FAW Officer provided advice/info on living with cougars & livestock. The owner & Officer discussed the options & possible outcomes if a cougar was removed within the area. It was determined not to pursue the cougar at this time.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar taking a house cat, caught on a game camera. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info. FAW Officer conducted a site visit the following day.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted on a trail camera. It appeared to be chasing a deer. RP believed it was a young cougar approx. 100lbs. RP wanted to let WDFW know for tracking purposes.

FAW rcvd. report of someone shooting at a cougar according to social media. FAW Officer responded to the residence home. RP informed the Officer there was a cougar in her yard near her dogs. The RP took her dogs inside & the cougar was near the deck when she returned outside. The RP fired a gun with a bird shot in it, over the cougar to scare it off. The cougar than ran away. FAW did not see any evidence of a cougar being injured or deceased.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar being shot in self defense. FAW responded to the scene. The RP was stalked by a cougar from approx. 10 yards away while walking the property. 2 warning shots were fired & the RP walked away. The cougar followed the RP & the cougar was then shot. FAW Officer recovered the cougar. It was a sub-adult male. FAW concluded the act was in self defense & the cougar was removed.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar was reported to cross the road @ an intersection. The RP did not provide contact information for an FAW Officer to contact.
FAW rcvd. report of a deer carcass possibly taken down by a cougar. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/information on cougars. FAW Officer advised the RP could dispose of the carcass.
FAW rcvd. report  of a cougar within 20 feet of a bicyclist. The cougar was off of the road.

FAW rcvd. report there was a cougar that crossed the road in front of a vehicle. The cougar continued south towards the golf course area. There have been several sightings but no confirmed depredations within the same area. FAW Officer & Houndsmen arrived to the area & located a fresh set of tracks leaving the road going into the timber. The hounds pursued for 20 minutes & a cougar was observed heading west in the forest & back up north to USFS property.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting that was spotted near the play structure @ Enchantment Park. The RP advised people in the area & they left. The RP had heard noises but was unable to describe them to the Officer. There was no physical sighting or other sign in the area. FAW Officer gave advice/info to the RP.
Property owner reported her roommate possible seeing three cougars in her front yard the previous Sunday evening. DFW officer was unable to confirm sighting.

FAW rcvd. report from USFS that a person shot at a cougar that was stalking him along the trail below Bear Lake. The RO saw the cat approx. 40 feet behind him & shot at the trail in front of the cat. The RP continued down the trail & the cat appeared in front of him. The RP shot the cougar twice in the chest & left the area. The RP was unsure if the cat was deceased or not. FAW Officer searched in the area with bear dogs & there was no evidence confirming a cougar was in the area.
FAW rcvd. report of several people spotting a cougar within 2 weeks. It was approx. 200 meters away from the RP & walked away. FAW gave advice on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. The internal organs had been removed from the carcass. The RP explained there was a cougar incident the week prior but did not report due to weather. Houndsmen were called out. A cougar was not located by Houndsmen, however confirmed cougar kill. One depredation permit was issued.
FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on a goat. Houndsmen were called out & issued one depredation permit for one cougar.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on 4 goats. The cougar was approx. 3 years old & spotted next to a goat pen. The cougar was treed near the property & dispatched. A camera was set on scene in the goat pen. 2 small carcasses were consumed by the cougar & possibly fed on by coyotes. The other carcasses were buried in hay. The game camera was set for a couple of nights.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat @ a ranch. Officers & Houndsmen responded to the scene. They were unable to locate the cougar that morning. The carcass had been fed on the previous night but not re-buried. A trap was set near the goat & was tied to the rear of the trap. A trail camera was placed. The cougar may have been spooked off, since it was interrupted & did not bury the carcass.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP saw a coyote in the yard in the AM & then saw a cougar following it from the bushes. The Cougar walked through the yard. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar attack on a dog. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP heard the cougar screaming during the attack & the dog going quiet after making noise. The RP did not know who the dog belonged to & it was out in a field. FAW Officers checked the area the next morning due to the time of the report/incident that night. Dog & Cougar tracks were found but no kill or attack site was located. FAW Officers looked for the dog owner but were UTL.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. The RP's dogs were barking, when they went outside there was a small, chained up goat deceased. There were puncture marks in the neck but it had not been fed on. The property borders a canyon that cougars are commonly in. Due to time delay & heat concerns, FAW did not set a trap. The RP was advised to keep her livestock pinned up each night, & provided advice/info about living with cougars & livestock.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar was running through a neighborhood. It was approx. 4ft tall with a  long tail & brown. FAW gave advice/info on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on 5 sheep. The RP saw a cougar at one of the carcasses & scared it away. The cougar had dragged a carcass across onto a fallen tree. The other carcasses were in a trailer on the property. 2 with neck punctures & 2 partial carcasses that were butchered. FAW Officers searched the property & were UTL the cougar. Houndsmen info were provided to the RP if the cougar was seen again. FAW Officer provided advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar walking through a yard in the afternoon. It was described as brownish in color, long tail & 4ft long. It walked from the cemetery into the bushes. FAW Officer contacted the RP. Advice/info was given on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on a goat. The goat was tied to a chain, 15ft long. There was debris covering the body & the shoulder area was consumed. The puncture wounds & examination confirmed it was a cougar kill. The goats had been rotating day & night on stakes to eat the vegetation. FAW Officer suggested the goats be moved to a secure area. The goats were then moved off location. Houndsmen were called, the next day 1 adult female cougar was removed from the property.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar incident with a sheep. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP had disposed of the carcass. The RP's neighbor also had a sheep killed that morning. FAW Officer evaluated the photos provided by the RP & walked the property. It appeared an animal had been going under the fence & bird feathers were also stuck in the fencing. FAW Officer provided advice/info. Unconfirmed cougar.
CITIZEN CALLED REF ONE OF HER SHEEP THAT WAS KILLED. OFFICERS INVESTIGATED AND BELIEVE THAT THE SHEEP WAS ACTUALLY KILLED BY A K9.
FAW rcvd. report from another Deputy of a poss. cougar sighting behind an apartment complex. FAW Officer advised the Deputy the area would be monitored.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a sheep. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene. There was a laceration & bite mark near the back of the neck & skull. The stomach was punctured. A trail camera was set. A coyote was captured on camera but no cougar. The carcass was removed the next day.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar spotted walking down the lower part of the Klemgard Park trail. The RP turned & ran back towards the residence area. The cougar was not following the RP. One pursuit only permit was issued to Houndsmen, in order to move the cougar out of the populated park area. The RP was advised to post signs within the park. The next day Officers walked around the park & trail, no cougar sign was found. A game camera was placed near the trail where the cougar was spotted.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on the RP's neighbors livestock. The incidents occurred weeks prior to the RP filing a report. RP provided photos of the cougar in a field next to the house. Several others in the area had seen the cougar as well. FAW Officer confirmed a juvenile cougar sighting through the photos. FAW Officer & conflict specialist will conduct a sight visit due to requiring an interpreter.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar was described as small & young, & ran across the RP's property early in the day. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/information.
Caller caught a cougar on their game camera last week. Officers provided advice.

FAW rcvd. report of a person walking & saw 2 cougars. The RP made themselves appear big & one cougar ran up the roadway. RP saw the 2nd cougar crouched down, when he yelled, backed away slowly & then shot 3 rounds into the air when it moved. The cougar walked parallel next to the RP when they fired a 4th round. FAW Offices & Houndsmen responded. 2 cougars were treed, hazed & then a paintball gun was used to shoot both cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on a deer, at Thorton Lakes Trail. FAW responded with to Bear Dogs & Park Rangers. The dogs pushed off a bear down the hill as it was trying to circle back to the carcass.  Officers determined the kill was initially made by a group of cougars & then fed on by the bear. The cougars were heard nearby in the brush. The carcass was left for the bear to clean up.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. The goat was buried approx. 200 yards away from the back deck. Camera was set on the kill site & 2 days late one cougar was removed from the area.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar attack on a horse. The  RP's neighbor shared they caught 3 yearling cougars on a trail camera & a volunteer on the farm saw the cougar @ night in a tree, then in the driveway. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene. The injuries on the horse were not consistent with a cougar. It was advised that there may have been a cougar in the area that spooked the horse causing the horse to injure itself on a gate or fence. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of  a poss.. cougar depredation on a calf. The calf owner leases to graze the cattle on the Wildlife Area. A young black steer carcass had its stomach & abdomen contents removed. A bite mark on the rear left leg caused some hemorrhaging. FAW determined a cougar kill & then fed upon by other predators. 1 cougar track was located.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a sheep. The sheep herd was contained in a small pen with electric fencing, & 2 guard dogs. The carcass was found on the electric fencing, which then collapsed because of the weight. The sheep had been drug approx. 15 yards from the kill site, where the blood stain was. There was one other live sheep that had minor injuries. Necropsy on the carcass confirmed a cougar depredation. Hounds detected a cougar scent, but were UTL to locate a cougar.

FAW rcvd. report of a sub adult cougar sighting near Colville city limits. The cougar was moving south along a field line near residences. FAW Officer provided advice/info to RP regarding living with cougars.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting behind someone's house in the trees. FAW Officer attempted to contact the RP & left a VM with information.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar incident with a dog. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP let out the dogs & believed to see a cougar jump on one. The cougar rolled over the dog in a playing manner, the dog ran back to the RP & the cougar ran off. FAW Officer gave advice/info to the RP.

CITIZEN CALLED REGARDING A COW ELK THAT WAS KILLED THAT HE SUSPECTED WAS COUGAR. OFFICERS RESPONDED AND BELIEVED THE COW TO HAVE DIED OF NATURAL CAUSES AND FED ON BY PREDATORS AFTER THE FACT. THERE WERE NO SIGNS OF STRUGGLE OR MARKINGS ON THE NECK OR CARCASS.

FAW rcvd. report of one sub adult cougar crossing a property @ 0100 hours. Images of the cougar were caught on the security camera, & not shared with WDFW. Advice/info provided. The RP has no livestock or outside pets causing concern.

FAW rcvd. report of a deceased llama believed to be related to a cougar. FAW Officers rspd. to the scene & examined the carcass. It appeared to be more than 2 days old & had been fed on by scavengers. No sign of a cougar kill. A 2nd deceased llama was found while searching the area. There was no signs of a predator. The llama was examined by a vet & was advised it may have been due to nutrition issues & poor conditions. FAW Officers gave info/advice.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting approx. 50 yards away from a residence. FAW spoke with RP & advised to bring in all animals into a secured area at night & other information. The area is rural & there has been no sightings or depredations reported within the general area. Advised to report if seen again.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar near a porch looking at the RP's dog. RP yelled at the cougar & it walked away. The cougar was approx. 15ft away from the door. RP's neighbor believes they saw the same cat earlier that week in the area. Houndsman were called & issued to haze the cougar away from the area.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting. The cougar was smaller in size & did not display any aggressive behavior. The RP walked into the house & upon returning the cougar was gone. RP does not know the direction of travel. FAW Officer gave advice/info on living with cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. Two people saw a cougar near the "F" building in the complex. A resident set up a drone & searched the dog trail but was UTL.. It was described as not a very big cougar. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar that spooked horses into woods. FAW Officer responded, the RP saw the cougar in the field approx. 150 yards away. The mule chased the cougar into the trees. No injuries were found on the mule or horse. FAW was unable to locate cougar tracks. The RP was provided with advice & education & advised the Officer she did not want the cougar kill. FAW determined the cougar was most likely passing through with no intent to go after the horse/mule.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting on a trail camera near a pasture. The area was known to have cougar depredations in the past. No cougar was located with the use of hounds. On 8/4/19 FAW Officer visited the residence & confirmed the trail camera photos. The photos showed a cougar walking along a corner of the fenced pasture.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting in a back yard. Described as a grey/beige color with a long curvy tail. The cougar walked across the street & disappeared behind a shed in the yard. Advice/info given.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on 2 sheep. The RP removed the carcasses & disposed of them in brush outside of the pasture. The cougar returned & fed on the carcasses. FAW Officer rspd. with K9 & pushed the cat off the covered carcasses. FAW Officer advised the RP animals would continue to feed on them until they were removed. RP was provided with fencing suggestions & given advice.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted over several days @ a chicken coop. The RP saw a small cougar near the chicken coop & threw a rock @ it, causing it to run off. The RP let the chickens out for the day & when the RP arrived back, 1 chicken was missing. The 2nd sighting the cat was back & staring @ the chicken coop. On 8/3 FAW Officer visited the residence & placed a trail camera on the property. On 8/5 the neighboring property saw the cougar. A cougar trap was deployed.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar incident with a horse. FAW Officer responded. The vet determine the injuries on the horse were not due to a cougar. FAW Officer found a cougar track near the fence line. FAW could not confirm the cougar attacked the horse. FAW gave advice/info on living with cougars & advised to fix the electric fencing. It was suggested a trail camera should be placed.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar seen in the residence back yard. The teenage son saw a cougar holding a raccoon in its mouth & was watching him & the dog. The RP drove the lawnmower towards it & it ran off. The RP did not see the tail or have a description. FAW gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a deceased foal, poss. due to a cougar. FAW Officer rspd. to the area. The foal was decayed with little evidence & the Gelding had wounds to the front chest & other scratches consistent with wired fencing. Coyote tracks were found in the area. Unable to determine. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. call of a poss. cougar depredation. 1 RP showed the FAW where the sheep depredation occurred on the evening of 7/31. The carcass had been buried by the RP but there was sheep wool on the ground. Sheep was approx. 30-40lbs, & the RP believes the dogs scared the cougar off before it fed. 1 female sheep had been attacked @ 3:30AM but was alive. The 2nd RP saw the dogs on top of an unknown animal that AM. 1 dog had a small leg injury. Both sheep had bite marks to the neck.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. The goat owner shot & killed the cougar responsible. FAW responded to the residence. The RP had seen an injured goat, a goat missing & spooked horses. A drag mark to the tree line located the deceased goat. The RP saw the cougar in a tree, shot the cougar which ran a short distance & died. The cougar was male & approx. 100lbs. The cougar was removed & DNA samples were taken for Biologists.

FAW rcvd. report of 2 cougar seen near a front porch of a residence. The cougars slowly walked off. The RP informed Officers a neighbors sheep had been killed the week prior. FAW Officer provided advice & information on living with cougars. No previous sightings or incidents had been reported at this location.

FAW rspd. to a cougar depredation on 2 lambs. FAW Officer set a trap but was unsuccessful. This had been the 2nd incident on the property within 30 days over the course of 5 years. FAW Police gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a sheep. The property has had past cougar depredations in previous years. The sheep were left over night in a large pasture & the sheep was killed at the top of the pasture away from light/buildings. The cougar returned that night to feed on the carcass. Due to temperature & terrain, hounds & trapping were not put in place. FAW advised to put the sheep in a more secure area & provided advice/information.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on 6 goats. FAW Officer responded & conducted a depredation investigation. The depredations occurred over night & 3 cougars had been sighted within the neighborhood earlier. The pasture had no electric fencing & was not secure. There were cougar tracks on the property & the wounds on the goats were consistent with a cougar attack. A 7th goat was missing & UTL. Education was provided on fencing for livestock.

FAW rcvd. report from USFS. A person in camp witnessed a cougar chase 2 fawns through the campground. USFS notified campers & posted signs. A local houndsman was called out to check the campground area. The houndsman confirmed the cougar was not in the area at this time.
CITIZEN CALLED REF CHICKENS AND TURKEYS MISSING ON HER PROPERTY. AN OFFICER RESPONDED AND VERIFIED IT WAS LIKELY DUE TO A BOBCAT AS THE TRACKS WERE TOO SMALL TO BE A COUGAR.

FAW rcvd. several reports of a cougar sighting on Mercer Island. 1st report showed footage of the cougar on a security camera walking up the driveway. FAW received addition sighting reports & noise reports. 2 other security camera videos showed the cougar walking in a wood area near a house. There have been no reports of depredations @ this time. Mercer Island PD & FAW Officers are working together to keep track of sightings.

FAW rcvd. report of a Cougar caught on camera in the area & reportedly hissed @ a person. FAW rspd. to the Pioneer park & nearby neighborhoods. After an extensive search of the park no cougar was located but 2 large raccoons were treed. Outside of the park KB Dogs picked up a scent in a neighborhood. No pursuit was activated as the scene was unsafe with high speed traffic, dense neighborhoods & no additional support.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar stalking a dog @ a residential area. FAW Officers responded & found the dog underneath the porch with a piece of wire wrapped around the back legs. The kids did not see a cougar only heard the dog struggling under the house. The dog was cut loose with wire cutters & did not appear injured. FAW gave advice/info.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in a front yard. FAW Officer contacted the RP. Info/advice was given.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar incident with horses. RP informed FAW that a cougar had killed 1 calf 3 days ago & injured 2 other calves. FAW Officer contacted the RP & rspd. to the scene. 2 calves had canine holes in the neck & the ears had been chewed apart. FAW Officer could not confirm the horses injuries. Houndsman rspd. hounds picked up a scent but were UTL the cougar due to house property lines.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar incident with a  horse & 2 calves. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene. RP informed FAW Officer a cougar chased the horses & killed a calf 3 days prior then injured 2 others. The 2 calves had canine bite marks on the neck & ears chewed off. The scratches & bite marks to the horses were not confirmed to a cougar. Houndsman rspd to the area. Hounds picked up a scent but were UTL due to house property lines.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on cattle. A 500lb calf was missing from the property & the RP suspected it was killed by a cougar. The RP & landowner have seen cougars around the cattle in years past. The RP informed Officers the neighbor had a calf just recently killed by a cougar that was not reported to WDFW. No carcass was located. Officers contacted the neighbor about their depredation & determined upon photo, it was consistent with coyotes not a cougar.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar moving in the area & possibly responsible for taking a house cat. The RP had heard a cougar & possibly seen it within the trees. FAW contacted the RP who agreed a number of predators could've taken the cat. FAW Officer inspected the area & there was no other evidence to confirm a cougar sighting. FAW Officer provided advice/info on living with cougars.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP saw the cougar on the road @ approx. 0530 hours. FAW gave advice/info on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on 2 dogs. Some remains were found near the residence. FAW Officer rspd. the remains showed it was most likely a cougar but not enough to confirm. FAW Officer contacted Houndsman. Info/advice was provided.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a small sheep. FAW responded & saw a large scratch on the front shoulder that went back to the mid section of the sheep. A portion of the back was missing, there was no injuries to the neck area. There was small scrapes on the hind legs. A trail camera was set on the outside of the fenced pasture.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar taking a chicken. FAW Officer contacted the RP. On 8/8/19 the RP replied back that the cougar returned taking a wild turkey in the AM. The RP had not seen the cougar but a relative had a video of it near the chicken coop. FAW Officer provided advice/info on living with cougars & suggested placing trail cameras around the coop. RP was advised to call WDFW for future sightings/incidents.

FAW rcvd, report of poss. cougar sounds outside a residential area. FAW advised the RP to contact WDFW if it was heard/seen again & trail cameras could be placed. FAW Officer gave advice/info on living with cougars & livestock.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on chickens & a turkey. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The cougar was seen again the following morning. RP placed trail cameras on multiple locations & was advised to call back if the cougar returned. Advice/info given.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar spotted in an orchard north of Pasco. The RP had seen the cougar 3 days prior to calling in. When the RP spotted it the cougar ran away. A beaver carcass was also found in the area & was freshly fed upon. FAW Officer provided advice/info on protecting the property & people. FAW advised to set trail cameras & call if there were any other signs or sightings.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting while kids were out riding bikes. The RP's kids saw the cat moving towards them, the kids got to the house & the dog chased after the cat. The cat then left. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP informed the Officer one of the kids had seen a cougar before in the area but they did not call it in. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar following a child on a bike. The child was riding a bike down a road when he saw a cougar. The child then turned around & biked the other way. When he turned around he saw the cougar was following him approx. 20 feet away. FAW Officer spoke with the parent & child about the incident on scene. The Officer was UTL the cougar but saw unidentifiable prints. FAW Officer provided advice/info on what to do if the child sees a cougar again & living with cougars.
RP has seen this cat on camera before and has not had any problems with it in the past. RP wanted to report the sighting. Report taken by district 2 biologist.

FAW rcvd. report a cougar was in a duck pen. The RP spotlighted the cougar & heard it making chirping noises. FAW contacted the RP & confirmed it was no longer in the pen. Advice/information was provided.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighted over the past few months. FAW Officer contacted the RP, the RP & neighbor had seen the cougar cross the road @ the same location multiple times. Confirmed sighting documented. Advice/info provided.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar in a driveway possibly with a domestic cat in its mouth. FAW spoke with RP, the cougar was spotted @ approx. 10:30 PM near the home in Morton. The residence borders cougar habitat conditions. FAW Officer gave advice/info on living with cougars & sent cougar brochures.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar killed @ a residence in act of an incident with a dog. The RP noticed the dog barking where the car port was located. The RP saw the cougar, it ran out & headed NW towards a creek. Later that day the cougar was under the car port again, the dog pursued the cougar. It ran up a tree & the RP shot it in the head. FAW Officer responded & found 2 chicken remains near the cougar site. Officer spoke with RP & removed the carcass. Tooth & meat sample taken.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting @ Kaiser Port Orchard Office. FAW Officer responded to the location. There was no sign of the cougar & the security cameras were not functioning. FAW Officer contacted the facility supervisor & provided advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on 3 sheep in a pen. There had been previous cougar conflicts @ that property. Houndsmen were called. All injuries were to the head/neck area. Drag marks showed the cougar was unable to get the sheep over the hotwire. Dogs treed 1 adult male cougar. The cougar was removed & DNA samples were taken. The cougar head was donated to the Kalispal Tribe for aging purposes. The tail was donated to the Houndsmen to train dogs. The sheep carcasses were removed.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting in the RP's neighbors field. RP believed it was stalking quail. The RP advised FAW there was livestock in the area & 2 neighbors have lost chickens within the prior days. FAW Officer went door to door in the area & provided a business card & advised them with info/education. The Officer did not find the two neighbors who lost chickens.
CITIZEN CALLED TO REPORT A COUGAR SEEN ON HIS AND A NEIGHBOR'S PROPERTY SIMPLY WALKING THROUGH THE AREA. RP WAS CONTACTED BY AN OFFICER WHO PROVIDED ADVICE ON WAYS TO DISCOURAGE THE COUGAR.

FAW rcvd. report of someone losing 5 ewes a week prior. RP saw a cougar dragging a deer across Blanchard Rd near the property the day the report was called in. FAW was unable to examines the ewes killed & informed the RP it would be entered as a sighting due to the circumstances & was advised to call 911 & FAW if there was another sighting or depredation.

FAW rcvd. report of a large cougar sighting in the back yard. RP described the cougar as healthy & 6ft long, approx. 40ft away from the house & headed west. No photo was captured. The RP believed it was there for several minutes & the RP was shaking a paint can to make noise.
FAW rcvd. report of a cougar near a residences gate. FAW Officer spoke with RP, the cougar was stalking a deer at the time.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar attempting to get into a livestock pen in the middle of the night a week prior. The RP's neighbor informed them today the cougar is on the property, the dogs are barking & there were sounds coming from the property. FAW Officer responded & walked the property. It was clarified 2 kids had seen the cougar cross Jones RD, but no depredations or incidents occurred. The livestock pens were secure & guard dogs are out 24/7. A trail camera was set. No cougar seen on footage

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar taking a goat from a yard @ dusk & injuring another goat. The RP called 2 days after the incident. 1/4 acre of the yard is penned with a small hut & rest was open. RP's neighbor found cougar tracks after the RP had thought the goat had just gone wandering to the neighbor. FAW Officer rspd. to the RP. Advice/info given.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting. The cougar was sitting within 50ft of a residences front door 2 days prior to the report. FAW Officer visited the site. The RP's had witnessed multiple cougar sightings within the last month, unsure if it was the same cat or not. FAW provided advice/information. No other reported sightings/depredations within the area in the recent weeks.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation involving 3 sheep killed in the days prior. FAW Officer responded & confirmed the most recent depredation was that AM. FAW Officer dug up the carcass & placed it out. A game camera was set. Conflict Specialist & Houndsmen were notified. Surrounding property owners were notified.

FAW set a trap on the property after a goat depredation occurred that day. The trap 1st caught a bear that was defensive of the kill. The bear was dispatched as the possible depredating predator. The bear was donated. The trap was reset & the next day a cougar was caught. The cougar was removed. The cougar & collar was returned to the UW field biologists for post-mortem necropsy. Collar data showed the cougar was in the immediate area. Cubs were a few miles away & UTL.

FAW rcvd report from a houndsman regarding a cougar sighting. The original RP saw the cougar around the house & then it was frightened off by the neighbor dogs. Due to the circumstances of a well fenced residential area near a busy highway & predation, the course of action was to document as a confirmed sighting & not attempt a locate & haze process.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar walking near the intersection of Mill & Waikiki. The RP believed it was coming from the Golf course, crossed the road southbound & went towards 5 mile Bluff. The cougar was described as bounding across the road, large with a long tail.
FAW rcvd. report from County of a cougar laying down in a residential area. FAW Officer contacted RP & provided advice/info. FAW Officer also spoke with neighbor who owns goat & provided advice.

FAW rcvd report of a poss. cougar sighting & a missing house cat. There were chickens in the neighborhood missing as well. FAW Officer contacted the RP. No one had seen the cougar but found remains of the house cat. It was undetermined what killed the cat. FAW Officer gave advice/info on living with cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting. The RP's 10 year old nephew saw a cougar in the back yard. The child ran back into the house when the cougar was seen. The RP's neighbor also saw a cougar in their back yard the previous day, approx. 300 yards away from the RPs residence. FAW Officer contacted the RP & gave advice/info. The RP was encouraged to report future sightings/incidents.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar incident. A dog walked into an orchard @ night & sounds were heard. The RP's believe it was a cougar attack.The dog was not located until the next morning. A large slice from neck to chest was on the dog. FAW advised it was not consistent with a cougar & the dogs injury was a result of something else. The RP believed it was a cougar & agreed to put up a camera. Due to time delay no trap or hounds initiated. After a search a mower was the culprit. Vets agreed.

FAW rcvd. report of 2 cougars acting aggressive. RP's daughter was hiking the Pacific Crest Trail near Waptus Lake when she had a confrontation with 2 cougars. The RP rcvd. the info through a text device. The daughter informed the mom she was fine but wanted it reported to the rangers. The daughter camped with another party the same night & then moved on to Spectacle lake the next day. No other wildlife was seen. Officers provided advice/info on cougars. RP was going to pass along to daughter.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar walking down a driveway. RP attempted sending a video but it was not visible. FAW Officer contacted the RP & determined the cougar was not acting aggressive & it was most likely an isolated sighting. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar crossing a road in front of a MV. The sighting was approx. 1/2 mile south of Boundary rd. The cougar was described a large with a long tail. The cougar was spotted @ approx. 0615 AM hours.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted in a field that took a deer. The RP saw the cougar feeding on the deceased deer. FAW Conflict Specialist provided advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of someone hearing a cougar in a vacant lot next to the RP's residence. RP believes the cougar was on his property a month ago. FAW Officer spoke with RP. The RP described a high pitch scream & assumed it was a cougar. Advice/info given.

FAW rcvd. report of hearing several cougar screams coming from the orchard. RP also spotted a coyote that night. The next morning a consumed deer was in the middle of the orchard but there was no bite marks on the neck area. FAW Officer spoke with RP & confirmed the cougar sighting based off of the facts provided.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP was out walking when it was sighted @ approx. 1630 hours. It had a long tail & was light brown in color. FAW provided advice/info on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar & cubs spotted @ Volunteer park drinking water. RP saw several posts of the sightings on a community page & was concerned about people being within a close distance. FAW Officer spoke with RP & responded to the scene. FAW was UTL the cougar & cubs. Advice/info was provide to the RP.

FAW rcvd 2nd hand report of a cougar sighted near a residence. The RP's friend was riding a side-by-side near the home when a cougar ran across the road. A local houndsman was contacted & updated of the sighting but did not respond. There have been repeated sightings within the area. Advice/info provided.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar attack on a horse. The RP's horse had scratches & cuts on it. FAW Officer rspd. & indicated the injuries were not due to a cougar. KBDS searched the pasture & no predator was detected. RP was given advice/info.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar was in a front yard & did not appear to be aggressive. FAW contacted RP, advice/info was provided.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting in a front yard in a residential area. FAW Officer spoke with RP who informed the Officer the cougar was spotted in the yard after hearing a chirping sound earlier & heard the cougar jump out of a tree. RP described the cougar as 80lbs & a long tail. The cougar ran under the SUV & was not aggressive. FAW gave info/advice & rspd. the next AM. The neighbors cameras that faced the property did not pick up any cougar footage.
FAW rcvd. report from Tribal Enforcement of a cougar on a game camera. FAW Officer contacted RP & provided advice/info on living with cougars. Encouraged to report future sightings.
FAW rcvd. report of a dog barking at a cougar in a yard. FAW Officer contacted RP & advised to keep animals in at night. RP wanted the sighting reported. Advice/info was given.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting near a fence. FAW contacted the RP who advised the cougar was forty feet outside of a fence behind a house. The cougar was jumping from rock to rock & described as approx. 280lbs. FAW Officer gave advice/info.
