FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting. FAW called RP & rcvd. no answer. The next AM the RP contacted the Officer & advised the mother had seen a cougar walk behind the residence, go down a trail from Suncadia towards the High School. The cougar was not aggressive. FAW Officer provided advice/ info.
FAW Rcvd. report of a cougar sighting near a residence. FAW Officer contacted the RP who informed the Officer a neighbor saw a large cougar was headed towards the State Park. Info/advice provided.

FAW rcvd. report of a person encountering a cougar & shot at it. FAW Officer met with RP. The RP was bear hunting, walking down a forest service road in the Umatilla National Forest & came across a cougar approx. 20ft away. RP attempted to scare the cougar away but it didn't move & started to growl. The cougar moved towards the RP & the RP shot at the cougar. The RP ran away unsure if the cougar was hit or not.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting. The cougar was reported to be in a tree & jump into a yard. A neighbor also informed FAW they saw a cougar a week prior. FAW was unable to respond to the area & believed it had cleared the area due to the info provided. Info/advice was provide. FAW Officers will monitor the area.
FAW rcvd. 2nd hand report of a poss. cougar sighting & incident with a dog in the city. The information regarding the dog incident was a false social media post. FAW spoke with RP & gave advice/info.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar hit by a vehicle. The cougar was deceased upon arrival of the WSP deputy. The cougar was a male kitten. DNA was collected & the carcass disposed of.

Citizen reported shooting at what was believed to be a cougar that had one of his chickens in its mouth. Houndsman was called and a cougar was not located, and the citizen was not entirely sure if he successfully killed the cougar when he shot at it. On 8/23/2019, a deceased bobcat was found near the residence. WDFW officers state that the homeowner believed that the bobcat was a cougar.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on 3 goats. The 3 goats were located 30 yards away from the pen & buried. Game camera was set.
FAW rcvd. report of a cougar being sighted in the AM within the orchard. FAW responded to the RP. Advice/info was given on working & living with cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar stalking a person walking in the dark. The RP was walking with a flash light when they saw a cougar, described as 3ft tall with a 12 inch wide face. An oncoming truck slammed on its brakes & the cougar took off. The RP went to a nearby gas station. The RP filed the report 2 days later. FAW Officer could not confirm the sightings based on the time delay, the description given & circumstances of the dark & using a flash light. There were no other reports in area.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting off Miller RD in Walla Walla Co. FAW spoke with the RP who informed the Officer a family member had seen the cougar on the family property in the AM. The 2nd RP saw the cougar & chased it down the road with a vehicle. FAW provided advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of several turkeys & chickens missing. RP believed it was due to a cougar even though they had not seen the cougar. The neighbors trail camera showed a cougar on footage & several other people had claimed to see it. RP's neighbor also found a site full of feathers. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on 6 sheep. FAW Officer responded & found puncture marks on the throats that showed little exterior damage. The sheep were most likely standing up not laying down when the depredation occurred. 1 had been dragged through the barbwire fence. A cougar track was located. A necropsy on a sheep was performed & showed a puncture on the upper thigh, scratch on a right rib & the throat bitten from underneath.
Property owner reported a possible cougar killing his goat near his residence. DFW officer confirmed depredation and set a trap for the cougar. The cougar was successfully trapped and euthanized.
FAW rcvd. report of a cougar seen near the Baptist Church in Jefferson Co. The cougar appeared to be stalking fawns. The report was 3rd party. No other info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar spotted while the RP was walking the dog in the late PM. RP tried to scare it off & flagged down a vehicle. The RP stood on a porch & waited until the cougar left. 911 was called & a deputy responded, finding a coyote in a yard nearby. FAW Officer gave advice/info. On 8/26 a call was rcvd. about a cougar sighting that was 2 days prior to the original incident.  2 game cameras & trap were set in the area.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar walking near the Littlerock Fire Department. FAW Officer contacted the RP's & provided advice/info about cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting @ a residence that was seen on camera footage. FAW spoke with RP & reviewed the photo provide. The photo showed a light colored, fluffy domestic house cat. FAW educated the RP.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on a goat. The night prior the 4 goats & 1 cow had been seen @ 2100 hours. @ 0600 hours 1 goat was missing. The goat was approx. 150 yards up the hill from the pasture. FAW examined the area & determined a cougar kill from the burial sight. A cougar trap was set using the deceased goat as bait. 8/22 a cougar was in the trap. The 110lb healthy male cougar was dispatched & removed. A tooth & tissue sample was taken. The trap was removed.

FAW rcvd. report of poss. cougar depredation on 2 goats. FAW Officer responded & found the 2 deceased goats tied to trees behind the home. Both goats had been fed on & 1 had a broken neck. A fresh cougar track was located next to the goats. Houndsman were called out & pursued, UTL the cougar. A trap was placed & a trail camera. Pictures of the cougar appeared within the next 3 days. All attempts to catch the cougar were unsuccessful. A permit was issued for one cougar to the Landowner/RP.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar incident on a horse. FAW Officer responded & examined the horses injuries. The wounds were not due to a cougar as they were to wide & barely punctured the hide. Only single marks were made & appeared to be horse bites. The scratches appeared to be from a tree branch that the horse most likely rubbed on.

FAW rcvd. a 2nd hand report of a cougar in a back yard of a residence. FAW Officer provided advice/information on cougars & informed RP it would be entered as a sighting. RP was encouraged to call back with any additions sightings or incidents.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting on the island in July & then several weeks later in August the RP saw reported seeing a cougar described as 3ft tall with a long tail. The RP observed it in the AM & an Island Deputy escorted the RP to the car shortly after seeing the cougar. FAW Officer provided advice/info to the RP @ each contact. A trail camera was placed on 8/10 & checked on 8/12 with no animals observed.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting approx. 100 yards away in a field across from a residence. The RP did not have a physical description of the cougar. RP previously had geese & chickens go missing. RP's neighbor also saw a cougar approx. 6 days prior. FAW gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting & a dog missing. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP's Golden Retriever took off while the RP was working outside. The RP advised this was in the orchard near the edge of the forest. No signs of a cougar was found.

FAW rcvd. email of a cougar sighting. FAW Officer spoke with the RP. Three people saw a large brown cougar with a long tail, approx. 60-0lbs walking up a driveway. The Cougar sat down & looked at the people. The people attempted to make noise by shutting the garage door several times & the cougar walked into the woods. FAW Officer provided advice/info living with cougars & encouraged the RP to report future sightings.

FAW rcvd. report 2nd hand there was a cougar sighted near a school in a wooded area. FAW Officer provided advice/info & advised sightings would be kept track of to determine if there was a public safety issue.

FAW rcvd. report of cougar sightings on private property. RP informed FAW a cougar was chasing a rabbit out of the woods into the yard. The RP's neighbor also saw the cougar near the residence a few days prior. A 3rd party also came across a deer carcass that they believed was killed by a cougar. FAW gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar spotted prowling goats. RP was able to yell & chase it off. When the RP turned around the cougar began to follow. RP reported the sighting to an Officer & the cougar had not been seen since. FAW Officer provided advice/info.
FAW rcvd. report of a cougar spotted on a trail camera on the 18th @ 2100 hours. The cougar was walking up the driveway.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in a field. There were 5 coyotes walking up the draw with the cougar following. The RP did not have any livestock/pets. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. female cougar with kittens who had been harvested last season, & now the kittens were in the area getting into garbage. FAW Officer contacted the RP & verified there was no footage or other reports from residents. FAW Officer will monitor the area. RP was advised to call if there are any sightings/incidents or concerns.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar issue in the area. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP's neighbors had 5 goats killed a week prior but did not report it & buried the goats. FAW Officer provided advice/info to the RP & neighbors about living with cougars & livestock.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting. The RP saw the cougar in the headlights while in a car. FAW contacted RP & the animal was no longer there. A DCSO Deputy was in the area shining lights & did not see anything. FAW Officers will continue to monitor the area.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar running through a back yard that was described as a juvenile. FAW Officer contacted RP & received a description of the cougar being 40-50lbs, tan in color with a longish tail. The cougar looked at the RP & then went into the brush & did not show aggression. There is a vast forested area near the location. A large amount of the area is Federal Land/JBLM training areas. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting. The cougar was dragging a freshly killed deer @ the end of the driveway. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info. RP was advised to call back if there was any issues.
FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting. The cougar was sighted at approx. 8PM 4 days prior. FAW Officer attempted to contact the RP & did not receive a response.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. It was grey in color had a long tail & was sighted walking into blackberry bushes going towards 11th Ave. FAW gave advice/info on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of several chickens missing, an outdoor cat & cougar spotted running from the pasture to the woods. RP's put the birds into a kennel except the peacock was unwilling. Later that night the RP heard/saw the peacock flying & the cougar in the pasture. The cougar was running towards the house after the peacock & the RP shot the cougar 3 times. RP attempted to call 2 off duty officers & went into a WDFW Office when the incident occurred. FAW Officer confirmed the incident.

FAW rcvd. report of an attempted cougar depredation on a dog. The cougar was in a front yard chasing the RP's dog around near 2 children by the front door. FAW Officer & Houndsman arrived & were UTL the cougar. FAW Officer gave advice/info to the neighbor as the RP was not at the residence. RP was encouraged to report any additional problems.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting. The cougar ran past the RP chasing a dog. There also was cows on the property poss. drawing the cougar in. FAW Officer contacted the RP & gave advice info. RP was advised to contact the Officer if there were any other issues or if the neighbors experienced a depredation on livestock.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP was walking a dog when they saw a cougar sitting at the edge of the road, approx. 10ft away. The RP used bear spray & made themselves appear large while backing away. The cougar walked back into the woods. FAW provided advice/info. FAW spoke with Houndsman who were going to run dogs later that evening in the area.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar had been sighted 2 weeks prior near the residents home. The cougar was near the creek bridge, it walked onto the street & then turned around & went back where it came from. RP was approx. 100 yards away. FAW gave advice/info on cougars.
FAW rcvd. report of hearing a noise & seeing a large animal in the trees. RP ran inside to get a gun & upon return the animal was gone. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar looking through a fence @ a dog. The RP's neighbors also spotted the cougar the night before. The RP also had had confirmed cougar problems in the past. FAW asked a Houndsman to respond, due to the time delay & rain the chances were slim to successfully track & locate the cougar. Houndsman did not respond. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar. RP was walking 2 dogs when they heard a growl, footsteps & saw a shadow. The RP then saw the cougar 3 houses down. The RP advised 4 days prior someone else saw the cougar while driving on I5 South. It was described as 100lbs. FAW provided advice/info.
Property owner reported a possible cougar killing one of his goats. DFW officer determined based on the injuries that it was not a cougar but most likely a coyote.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting in East Wenatchee. The following day the Officer contacted the RP. The RP saw a cougar in some sagebrush & it was watching some deer. It then left & headed towards Valley Tractor. The area has lots of orchards & hill side for the cougar to roam around. FAW Officer gave advice/info.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar was walking in the road & then went into the bushes. FAW Officer contacted the RP. FAW Officer gave information/advice.
Property owner reported a possible cougar sighting near the residence. Conflict specialist was able to confirm sighting and provided advice.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar attacking a neighbors horse. FAW Officers responded. The cougar had jumped the fence & ran off upon arrival. After speaking with RP's the cougar had been walking through the pasture not attacking the horse. FAW checked the area & was UTL. One RP showed pictures of the cougar tracks that an Officer also located. FAW Provided advice/info & advised to call if seen again.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on a sheep. This depredation was #6 total over the summer for the Landowner. 3 of the 6 were reported within a timely manner. Houndsman have been working in the area & running dogs up to three times a week looking for the cougar, possibly 2 cougars.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar making a screeching noise. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice & information.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting on the property. RP believes it was stalking her. FAW Officer spoke with RP & concluded it may have been returning to a kill site. RP was going to look around the property & remove the kill if it was found. FAW Officer gave advice/info on living with cougar & livestock.

FAW rcvd. report of someone spotting the front half of a cougar. FAW Officer contacted the RP. RP heard a noise near the ditch & has noticed the quail have not been in the area. FAW Officer advised the area would be monitored & they would not be responding to look until later.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting along SR 241 near the Wheeler Gas Station. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP was traveling north bound when they believe they saw a cougar or tiger. The RP saw it run across the road into the Mabton Bridge Access Area. The RP was unable to give clear descriptors. FAW gave advice/info.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP was walking dogs when the cougar was spotted. FAW Officer contacted the RP & gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting. The cougar was walking behind a house on a neighbors property. The cougar was approx. bigger than a German Shepherd Dog. The RP's neighbors lost 2 goats 3 weeks prior to the reported sighted, unsure if related. FAW gave advice/info.
FAW rcvd. 2nd hand report of a poss. cougar crossing the road @ 0430 hours. FAW gave advice/info on cougars.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar behind a cemetery while the RP was walking two dogs. FAW Officer gave advice/info & advised to call back if any future sightings/incidents.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar walked from the woods, across the street & into some brush. It was described as well fed & healthy. FAW gave advice/info on cougars.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted near a garden @ a residences home. The cougar appeared to be following some deer. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting within the city limits of Ephrata. Several Grant Co. Deputies saw the cougar. FAW Officers responded to the last location near the High School. 45 minutes later a 2nd RP said the cougar was running through his field, approx. 5 miles north of the Officers location. The cougar was headed northbound. Officers cleared from the location.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a sheep. The property has had past depredation incidents. The carcass was inspected & bite marks on the neck were consistent with a  cougar. The fenced pen was hog wire & 4.5ft tall with hot wire on the top. Neighboring property owners were spoken too about the hound pursuit. Houndsman arrived & located a scent but UTL the cougar. A game camera was placed on the carcass. The game camera was removed 09/08/19.
FAW rcvd. report of poss. 3 cougars walking on the roadway. They traveled from left to right headed towards the river. RP described them as very large.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. It was walking near the orchards/vineyards. It was approx. 250 yards away.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on 3 goats. The cougar took one goat the day prior & one the day of. FAW Officers responded to the property & confirmed a cougar kill site. One of the goats was cached & fed on. The other two were deceased but not fed on. A kill permit was issued to the RP's neighbor.
FAW rcvd. 2nd hand report of a cougar in a backyard on 2 occasions. FAW Officer contacted the property owner & provided advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar was described 2 1/2ft tall, long with a slinky tail. The RP's neighbors also possibly saw the cougar. The cougar was spotted near a stream. FAW Officer spoke with the RP. The RP described sign on the property that was consistent with coyotes. FAW Officer gave advice/info & advised to call in the future if any sightings or incidents occurred.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. The goat was found with marks in the neck area the next AM. The RP was going to purchase a cougar tag but wanted to let FAW know. FAW Officer responded & confirmed the goat had been buried already. There was no pictures, but a cougar has been sighted in the area. FAW Officers advised the RP they would stop by to look around the area. Info/advice was provided.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP saw it approx. 2 weeks prior as well. FAW Officer responded to the scene & was advised there was a licensed cougar hunter on the property. The RP had seen the cougar in the yard that AM. The RP expressed concern for pets & that 1 dog fought & treed the cougar. FAW was UTL tracks or sign on the property. The dog had no injuries. FAW Officer gave advice/info on living with cougars & livestock.

FAW rcvd. report of a female cougar sighting with 5 kittens that were almost fully grown. The cougars were crossing the road on Hwy 12. The RP advised there was a diary farm nearby & the cougars had been spotted on a game camera in the past.
FAW rcvd. report of a deer carcass that was killed by a cougar within the last 24hrs. The carcass was partially buried. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info on living with cougars.
Reporting party reported a possible cougar on a nearby trail. DFW officer was unable to confirm sighting.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar killing a deer @ a private residence. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP informed FAW that a cougar chased a deer into their barn & kill it. The deer kill was not fresh & had maggots. They removed the carcass & did not see the cougar, only injuries on the deer. FAW Officer gave advice/info on living with cougars & was advised to call in the future if any sightings/incidents.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting on the golf course. It was described as a juvenile cougar. FAW gave advice/info on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on a dog. FAW Officer responded & was shown the dog which was outside of the fence. The dog had one large puncture wound under the neckline. It appeared the cougar & dog had an altercation the road. After following blood towards the creek there was a set of cougar tracks. 2 trail cameras were set on the carcass. Houndsman called. 2 hunters camping on the property were given permission to euthanize the cougar if it returns to the carcass.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar pursuing cattle. The sighting occurred the night before the report @7PM. There were no depredations. FAW contacted the RP. The RP was moving cattle @ dusk along the fence line. There was a noise & the RP saw a cougar running after the calves at the back of the heard. The RP drove the ATV towards the cougar & it ran into the woods. FAW Officer gave advice/info on living with cougars/livestock.

FAW rcvd. reports of multiple cougars in a camp site on Eagle Creek Rd. The RP was unable to get into tent. FAW contacted RP that informed the Officer, upon returning to camp they saw a cougar, possibly 2 in the headlights. They were just past their tent. The RP's left the area & returned the next AM. RP only saw the heads & they were laying down. FAW gave advice/info. Due to heavy rainy weather, no sign was located. The area is heavily wooded & a sighting would be normal.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting in a field & deceased deer behind the residence home. The cougar was chasing a fawn. FAW contacted RP & advised Houndsman were ENRT to chase the cougar off the carcass & remove the carcass. While in progress, the neighbor shot at the cougar. Houndsman arrived & treed the cougar. The cougar was bleeding heavily & was euthanized. 1 valid hunters tag was filled & sealed.

FAW rcvd. 2 hand report of 2 cougars spotted since May. There were prior depredations at the RP's land last year. That Cougar was removed but the RP is worried about a new one. FAW Officer spoke with RP & confirmed the newest sightings were spotted by other people. One sighting was in May & one was in the AM the day of the report. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd report of a poss. cougar depredations on 5 sheep and/or goats. FAW Officers responded & confirmed a cougar kill. Trail camera set on 2 carcasses. 2 days later, the neighboring landowner saw the cougar close to self & shot it, mortally wounding it. Conflict specialist located & euthanized the cougar. Cougar was provided to the valid hunter. Camera was left over night again & no cougar was spotted. Camera was removed. Advice/info given to landowner.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on a sheep. The RP's dogs scared the cat off while it was consuming the sheep. FAW Officers & Houndsman arrived. There were puncture marks on the neck, a trail camera was set & the property was walked. Hounds did not pick up a scent. The carcass was removed. FAW Officers notified surrounding properties & gave advice/info.

FAW rspd. to a poss. cougar depredation on 3 sheep. @ arrival the Officer was informed a turkey had also been taken earlier that day. 3 sheep had been taken the night before, two were on site & one gone. Bite marks & prints confirmed it was a cougar kill. Houndsman were called. One cougar was removed.

FAW rcvd. report of a missing goat & 2 deceased goat with drag marks. FAW Officer responded & found puncture wounds in the neck area. 1 goat was partially consumed & was dragged next to the fence. Remote camera was set on the 2 carcasses. The next day, the camera showed the cougar had returned. Houndsman arrived, 1 adult female cougar was treed & dispatched. The cougar was donated to a valid hunter. FAW & RP worked on securing animals into a shelter.

FAW rcvd. report of a 2nd hand report sighting a cougar along SR240 & Edison St, Kennewick. The RP's friend had seen the animal @ 05:30AM. Benton County Deputy checked the area. The Deputy was UTL a cougar & did not observe anything. The Kennewick PD was also updated.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar on the street walking towards Middle St. RP described it as mangy, thin, long with pointy ears & a straggly tail. FAW gave advice/info. Most likely a coyote. The RP did not know the difference between cougar & coyote.

FAW rcvd. a 2nd hand report of a poss. cougar sighting on SR240 & Edison St. RP's friend saw the cougar @ 0530AM hrs. A Benton Co. Deputy checked the area & did not observe anything. The Police Department was informed as well. No more sightings were reported.

Property owner reported a possible cougar taking one of his pigmy goats. Resident towards the cougar several times unsure if he hit it. DFW officer and houndsman attempted to track the cougar unsuccessfully. DFW was unable to confirm and skeptical that it was a cougar.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting in a driveway & tracks in the area. FAW Officer contacted RP & confirmed video footage of a cougar running through the yard. RP had no livestock, but 2 small dogs. FAW gave advice/info.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar walking through a yard. RP was informed about this 2nd hand. FAW encouraged the RP to have the person who spotted it call in.

FAW rcvd. report of 4 cougars spotted on a camera. The footage showed 3 poss. juveniles with another cougar on a bank with rocks FAW confirmed footage & provided advice/info. RP advised neighbors in the area.
FAW rcvd. report of  glowing eyes @ night & hearing a growl/purring noise. RP believes it was a cougar. FAW Officer gave advice.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar poss. attacking a dog the week prior. Today the RP was hanging clothes on a clothes line & heard a cougar growling from the bushes. RP reported it within the hour. FAW Officer gave advice/info & updated the contracted Houndsmen in the area.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting. FAW Officer responded. The RP saw a large cat outside of the back door. It had a long curled tail, was tan/orange in color & the tail was fuzzy. FAW Officer saw no evidence of a cougar in the back yard.
FAW rcvd. report of a cougar walking near Sunset Memorial park @ 0715 AM hours. FAW Officer contacted RP & confirmed the sighting by the description.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. It was spotted on the open hillside. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a donkey. FAW Officer responded. The RP believes it was killed day prior to the day of the report. The kill pattern & broken neck confirmed a cougar depredation. No cougar sign was located due to weather & foot traffic. The carcass was confirmed to be deceased for several days according to decay. The carcass was removed. Advice/info was given & encouraged to report future incidents.

FAW rcvd. report of an 80lb female cougar that was in a tree across from an elementary school. The cougar was darted, tagged & removed from the location. The cougar was released the following day near Mt. Spokane.

FAW rcvd. report of a missing calf poss. due to a cougar. The calf was stuck in the fence & making noise. Then later the calf disappeared. The RP believed a cougar was drawn in & took the calf. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The scene was clean, the neighbor found tracks 200 yards away. FAW Officer handled the situation & the calf was found alive.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar spotted in a tree. Several kids told the RP they were in a park near a trail when they saw the cougar. FAW gave advice/info to the RP about cougars.
Reporting party reported a possible cougar killing a deer. RP is interested in legally hunting the cougar if it returns and was provided advice  and education by the officer.
Reporting party reported a possible cougar killing a deer nearby his residence. DFW officer was not able to confirm it was a cougar but  provided advice and education.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. FAW Officer responded to the scene & found the deceased goat that was drug to a fence. The head & neck had been chewed off & the left front shoulder was fed on. Consistent damage & behavior of cougar, a trail camera was set on the goat carcass.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar in the area. The RP found a deceased deer on the property & the carcass had been fed upon. FAW Officer contacted RP & advised to remove the carcass. After reviewing photos of the deer, FAW Officer believes it was K9 related. It's not uncommon for cougars to be on the hill or in the orchards in that area. Info/advice given.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting that was spotted on the previous Friday. The cougar was seen crouching through the yards. People who were walking in the area with dogs were picked up by others in vehicles. FAW Officer attempted to contact the RP multiple times with no success.

FAW rcvd. report of a missing sheep that was then found. The RP has a high fenced area & believed a cougar took it over the fence. There had been previous issues with cougars on the property. Other neighbors had seen the cougar as well. RP sent photos of the carcass. The carcass was partially buried & you could only see the hooves. The kill site was consistent with a cougar. The RP was going to sit on the kill site & has a cougar tag. RP was advised to contact the Office if the cougar came back.

FAW rcvd. report of poss. cougar sounds. RP heard whistling noises & had heard about poss. cougar sightings within the area. FAW Officer advised the sighting reported had been false. FAW Officer provided advice/info regarding cougars & advised to contact if there were future sightings/incidents.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in the park. The RP had seen a large animal in the park the previous day that was near a nature sign. The RP saw a large cat with big paws & a round face. FAW Officer gave advice/info & advised they would go to the location to look.

FAW rcvd. a 2nd report of a poss. cougar sighting that was approx. 30ft away from a front door. The RP thought it may have been the same cougar that was spotted years ago. The neighborhood also had several pets missing. FAW gave advice/info on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar cub jump onto a porch while the RP was outside. This occurred 4 days prior to the report. The cub was curious & the RP was able to scare it off. The RP then heard a larger cat sound nearby after it had ran off, believing it was the mother. There was no other cougar sign on the property seen by the RP. FAW gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting. The cougar was approx. 100lbs & ran through the property. The RP did not want to leave the house. FAW Officer contacted the RP & confirmed the description to be a cougar. FAW Officer went out where the RP thought it was bedded down. The Officer was UTL the cougar or any sign. Advice/info was given.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. small cougar being sighted behind an apartment complex. The RP had heard about the cougar from several neighbors. There is a wooded area behind the parking lot where the poss. cougar had been sighted. RP was unable to provide any info regarding the sightings or who saw it. RP believes it was last seen over a week ago prior to reporting it. FAW gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting near the corner of Mason & Montgomery St. It walked from a residents yard into the brush. FAW Officer spoke with residents in the area & provided advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting. The cougar was captured on a video camera, attempting to go after a lamb in a fenced pen. The cougar was unable to get to the lamb. FAW Officer contacted the RP, the RP informed the Officer the lamb was going to be taken off of the property soon. Advice/info given.
WDFW officers and conflict specialist responded to a call about a goat depredation. A game camera was set up to confirm the cougar sighting and hounds were called out as well.

FAW rcvd. report of poss. 2 cougar cubs in the area. Multiple raccoons had been found deceased  in yards & the cubs were described as growling & hissing @ people. FAW Officer & Conf. Specialist rspd. to the area & educated the neighborhood through the HOA.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene & confirmed the goat was killed by a cougar. 2 trail cameras were set on the carcass. @ approx. 0500 the next day the owners saw the cougar on the trail camera. The Officers & 2 Houndsmen rspd. & treed the cougar approx. 1/4 mile away from the carcass. The cougar was dispatched & removed.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted near a residences porch. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP's dog was on the porch @ the time & believed the cougar may have been stalking it. When the RP opened the door the cougar ran away. FAW Officer provided advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting near a bus stop in the AM. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP did not see the cougar but a neighbor did. FAW Officer gave advice/info on cougars & advised the neighbor who saw the cougar should contact him. The neighbor did not call the Officer.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar was sighted after 9PM in the driveway when the RP let the dog outside. The RP shined a flash light & spotted it. The cougar was described as 2-3ft tall. There is a healthy deer population in the area. The RP advised the neighbors of the sighting. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a sheep. The sheep had been almost entirely consumed. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene. There were 2 puncture holes in the throat & other wounds consistent with a cougar kill. Houndsman rspd. hounds located 1 adult male cougar that was treed & dispatched. DNA samples were taken & the cougar was sealed.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar walked by @ approx. 1430 hours. It was described as large with short hair & moved like a cat. FAW gave advice/info on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting & a deer carcass. The carcass was approx. 50 yards from the house. FAW Officer contacted RP & provided advice/info. RP was advised to remove the carcass & to call back if there was any issues.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. injured cougar behind a residences shop. FAW Officer visited the site and did not locate any fresh sign of cougar. There was tall grass in the area. FAW Officer provided advice & info to the RP & neighbors.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in a populated area. The RP wanted to advise FAW for information only. Unconfirmed.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on 2 goats, 3 days after the initial incident that occurred 09/14 RP did not contact any other agency within those 3 days. The Officer rspd. to the scene & confirmed the cougar depredation. The fencing was 2.5 -3ft tall & easy access for a cougar to get it. The carcasses had been fed on by coyotes & a bear. The other goats were moved to the barn. FAW Officer advised to increase the fence height & gave info/advice. RP was advised to report incidents ASAP.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP observed 5 cougars in the road. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP described the cougars having 2-3ft long tails & the size of a Great Dane. FAW Officer gave advice/info.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting 3-4 days after the sighting occurred. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info on living with cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a missing goat & poss. cougar depredation. The RP put all the goats in the barn the previous night & in the AM one was missing. The RP searched the area & couldn't find any evidence of a cougar or find a carcass. FAW Officer rspd with a County Deputy. The goat was approx. 50 yards from the barn with its horns stuck in the fence.

FAW rcvd. report of poss. 2 cougars near a mailbox. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP observed 2 cougars running through the property. RP did not have livestock. FAW Officer gave advice/info, the RP was to advise neighbors who had livestock about the sighting.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar being shot while 2 hunters were out hunting grouse when a cougar lunged @ them. FAW Officer contacted the RP. While walking to the truck the RP saw a cougar run towards the dog, fearing it was going to attack, the RP shot once with a bird shot which slowed it down. The RP shot 2 more times, it was still alive & shot once more. FAW Officer observed the cougar was a young kitten. The carcass was removed. FAW Officer gave advice/info to the RP's.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP had observed a poss. cougar roaming around the residence. RP's neighbors had also heard a scream sound around the same time the RP had seen the cougar. FAW Officer provided advice/info.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar ran through the yard twice in the AM. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. There were cougar tracks in the mud & the carcass was in the same location since it was tethered. FAW Officer rspd. with a Houndsman that evening.

FAW rcvd. report of a game camera photo capturing a cougar. The picture was captured the previous weekend near the RP's home. FAW Office gave advice/info on living with cougars. FAW Officer confirmed the cougar photo.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on a goat. The incident occurred the previous night. FAW rspd. to the scene & investigated. The RP saw the cougar walking by the house. A gun was shot in the air attempting to scare it away. The next day the RP found 1 deceased goat that was partially fed on inside the goat pen. There had been a previous depredation nearby 1 1/2 weeks prior to this incident but there was a time delay in the report. The Officer confirmed as a cougar kill.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting on a game camera. The camera also captured a deer photo. FAW Officer contacted the RP. There was no cougar sighting/photo captured.

FAW rcvd. report of poss. cougar encounter with a Rottweiler. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP did not see a cougar or the incident occur. RP found cougar prints near the home. The dog was outside of the kennel when it was injured. The RP sent pictures of the animal prints but they were unrecognizable. FAW gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of poss. cougar den near a residences home. FAW Officer met with the RP & was shown the area. An uprooted tree with deer droppings nearby was observed. The RP provided game camera photos & there was no cougar or wildlife observed. The RP was concerned with the cougar living nearby not if it was passing through. FAW Officer provided advice/info on living with cougars & encouraged the RP to report sightings/incidents.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar was behind the RP @ approx. 100 yards while the RP was working on a ramp. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP informed the Officer about the sighting & that the Cougar killed a turkey. FAW Officer provided advice/info on living with cougars & advised to call for any future sightings/incidents.

FAW rcvd. report of poss. 2 cougar sightings. The 1st sighting was a 2nd hand report & the 2nd sighting was a 1st hand report. The RP saw a cougar approach to the side of them & when they stood up it stopped, turned & walked away. The cougar was approx. 50ft away. FAW Officer contacted the RP. FAW Officer provided advice/info & advised the RP they could purchase a cougar tag since it was open season.
Property owner reported a cougar killing a deer on her back porch and she shot it euthanizing it while in the act. DFW officer responding confirming the sighting and removed the carcass.
Property owner reported a possible cougar killing his two goats. DFW officer confirmed the cougar depredation and provided advise and education.

FAW rcvd. report of 3 deceased deer in the area with the hind quarters consumed. The RP's neighbor saw a cougar several days before & believes the deer may have been a cougar depredation. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP's neighbors had removed the carcasses before the Officer could examine them. FAW Officer gave advice/info & advised they would check the area for any sign.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar & 2 cubs walking in front of  the RP's neighbor @ the Seattle Waterlines on Kelly Rd. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP informed the Officer the neighbor was running on the trail when the cougars were spotted & they were concerned about the populated area  as well as livestock. FAW Officer provided advice/info on living with cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of poss. cougar depredation on 2 goats. FAW Officer confirmed a cougar kill. The carcasses were both picked clean. Houndsman were called out but UTL the cougar. A trap was not usable @ the time. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of cougar depredation on a sheep. Local Houndsman were called. FAW Officers rspd. to the scene & confirmed the injuries were due to a cougar. Houndsman P/U on a scent but were UTL the cougar. A trap was set with the sheep carcass. Overnight cows had activated the trap door, but no cougar was in it. A temporary fence was put in place around the trap. FAW Officers are monitoring the trap.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. It was walking the edge of the residences property.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar shot in self-defense. The RP believed it was going to pounce on them. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene. The cougar had been shot after the 2 people walked out of the woods. The cougar was crouched down & looking at them. The cougars face had trauma from the shot. FAW inspected the cougar. It was a female cougar, between 60-70lbs. FAW Officer disposed of the cougar & took DNA samples.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in a residences yard. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The cougar was approx. 20 yards near the residence, it ran into a fence & then left. It was spotted several times over the past few weeks. RP believes it was an adult cat. FAW Officer provided advice/info & advised to call for future sightings.

FAW rcvd. report of a dog chasing a cougar up a tree. RP also had a newborn alpaca that was missing. FAW Officer gave the neighbor & a hunter to remove the cougar out of the tree. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene & confirmed the cougar had taken several chickens & the baby alpaca. The carcasses were buried under the tree the cougar was in. The hunter tagged & harvested the cougar. The cougar was young. Houndsman rspd. & checked the area for any other cougars, UTL.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting caught on camera. The photos from the trail camera were confirmed by a FAW Officer. The cougar was near a water trough in the photo. FAW provided advice/info on living with cougars & advised to report future sightings.

FAW rcvd. report of someone being chased by a cougar. FAW Officer contacted the RP & was advised while jogging before sunrise they observed a set of eyes with the headlamp on. The RP stopped & back slowly away after realizing it was a cat. The RP called 911 & got a ride from a MV driver nearby. The RP was not chased by the animal. Oroville School District was advised. FAW Officer checked the area & located only deer tracks & a black house cat, no cougar sign.
FAW rcvd. report a cougar sighting. The cougar crossed a road & was walking towards the home. FAW Officer contacted RP & confirmed the sighting. Advice/info provided.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP informed the Officer there were cougar prints. FAW Conflict Specialist contacted the RP & provided advice/info on living with cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a lamb. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene & confirmed a cougar killed 2 sheep. 1 was fed on & cached, the other was killed & left alone. The 2 sheep were removed & the 3rd alive sheep was moved to an enclosure. The sheep were not in a closed pen during the incident. FAW Officer provided advice/info & advised to call if future sightings/incidents.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar issue in Stevens Co. FAW Officer arrived @ the scene. The RP's brother had seen a cougar in the garage. The RP saw a young cougar under a vehicle in the garage. A warning shot was fired @ the cougar, the cougar hissed & moved forward. The RP shot again thinking the cougar had been hit. FAW Officer searched the area & was UTL the cougar or evidence the bullet hit the cougar. FAW Officer gave advice/info on living with cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a sheep & injured others. FAW Officer contacted the RP & rspd. to the scene. 6 sheep were injured, 2 severely injured & one was deceased. Bite marks & injuries to the deceased sheep confirmed a cougar kill. The sheep tracks in the pen covered any other tracks. FAW Officer advised the RP to move the sheep to a safer area & issued one kill permit for 5 days. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

Property owner reported a possible cougar killing 12 of their peacocks. DFW officer responded determining that it was either a small cougar or a canine that killed the birds. A depredation permit was issued to a local houndsman but after several attempts found no cougar.

Property owner reported a possible cougar killing two f his chickens also stating that he has seen a cougar nearby several times that week. Resident has a current cougar tag and stated he would use it if it returned. DFW officer provided advise.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP saw a cougar walking through the property. FAW Officer contacted the RP but was unable to reach. Unconfirmed.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar in the area. The RP informed the Officer the cougar has taken barn cats & deer near the home. The RP shared the neighbor lost a sheep within the last week & there is other livestock on the property. The sheep was not reported. The RP had trail camera photos of the cougar. FAW Officer issued Houndsman a permit to remove one cougar.

FAW rcvd. report of someone poss. shooting @ a cougar that tried to pounce on a person while hiking along the trail near the power lines. The RP shot @ the cougar from 10-15ft away after it was in a pouncing position towards them. The RP was unsure if the cougar was injured or deceased. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The next AM the RP went out to look for the cougar & only found a few drops of blood. The RP updated the Officers.
Caller reported a cougar sighting near his residence. Advice was given by officers.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene. The deceased goat had been drug to the corner of the pen, the stomach was opened & fed on. A cougar print was located near the goat. The RP had a blind set up in the pen & was given permission from the property owner to shoot it. FAW Officer issued a kill permit for the cougar.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. RP saw the cougar burying the goat & it then moved to the other side of the fence. FAW Officer contacted the RP & gave advice/information about protecting livestock & property. RP had contacted 911 & a King Co. Deputy responded. FAW Officer advised they would stop by @ a later time.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting The cougar was seen @ 0100 hours. The cat hopped over a bush. The RP described it as a large cat. FAW Officer gave info/advice.

FAW rcvd. report of sheep missing & a spooked horse due to a poss. cougar sighting. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene & found coyote tracks as well as old sheep remains. The neighbor had seen a cougar in the area on occasions & there were other known predators in the area. FAW Officer gave info/advice on living with livestock & cougars. 1 permit was issued to the RP.

FAW rcvd. report of poss. cougar depredation on 3 sheep. Houndsman rspd. to the area & removed one adult male cougar, approx. 3-4 years old. The sheep carcass was removed. FAW Officer spoke with the RP about preventative measures & gave advice.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP saw a cougar cross the driveway & walk into the neighbors yard. FAW Officer contacted the RP. It was described as younger, tan & black tipped ears. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

Property owner reported his sheep being killed by a possible cougar. DFW officer responded and based on the evidence and the wounds determined that it was not killed by a cougar but by a K-9, domestic dog.
Reporting party reported a possible cougar sighting/kill. DFW officer was unable to confirm it was a cougar.

FAW rcvd. report of a person walking a dog in the AM when they spotted 2 cougars. 1 was small with spots. The dog did not notice the cougar, nor did the cougars notice them. RP watched the cougar turn a corner & then left the area. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice & safety information.

FAW rcvd. report of a deceased fawn believed to be killed by a cougar. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The fawn had a bite mark on its throat & the loins had been fed on as well as the hams. Multiple residents in the area had seen the cougar. It was advised for the RP to set a trail camera on the carcass. FAW Officer gave info/advice & provided brochures to the camp.
Citizen heard from neighbors of a possible cougar sighted in the neighborhood. WDFW officers are unable to confirm the sighting at this time.
Received a second hand report of a sighting of two cougars near Mary M Knight school at 1300 hours.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting from the previous evening in a yard. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The neighbor had seen a cougar several days prior & the RP wanted information about cougars. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a dog. The RP had buried the dog & the incident had occurred several days prior to receiving the report. FAW Officer attempted to contact the RP & the RP didn't respond.

Property owner reported a possible cougar killing a near the residence. DFW officer confirmed that it was not killed by a cougar but most likely a domestic dog based on the injuries. Deer carcass was removed.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on 3 sheep. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene. The carcasses were examined & a cached site was near the lamb. The area was on a creek & heavily wooded. 1 lamb survived & there were two bite marks below the neck. The others had neck & nose bite marks. It was determined a juvenile cougar was most likely responsible. A trail camera was set. Advice was provided.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar crossed the gravel driveway & was walking past the RP. The RP believes it was well fed, healthy & larger than a 70lb dog.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on several sheep. FAW Officer & Houndsman rspd. to the scene. The hounds picked up a scent but no cougar was located. 2 trail cameras were set @ the carcass. @ 1822 hours the RP's saw the cougar. FAW & Houndsman rspd. & dispatched the adult male cougar in a tree. A tooth & DNA sample were collected. The cougar was approx. 6 years old & 101lbs. The carcasses were disposed of.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in the area. FAW Officer attempted to contact the RP & rcvd. no answer.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a dog. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The dog had been missing for 10 days & was found deceased in the field on 40 acres. No neck wounds were visible but there were lacerations on the side, & there were facial wounds. The RP's neighbor had encountered a large collared cougar approx. 2 weeks ago in the area. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar was described as 100lbs, long tail, tan & cat like. FAW Officer contacted the RP. It was scene outside of the sliding glass door. The RP's cat ran towards the door & the cougar was chasing it until it saw the RP. FAW Officer gave info/advice on living with cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of  a poss. cougar depredation on a sheep. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene & investigated. There were 4 deceased sheep. The feeding patterns & tracks confirmed a cougar kill. Houndsman rspd. Houndsman euthanized the cougar. The RP had a valid cougar tag & was given permission to tag the cougar.
FAW rcvd. report of a deceased deer that was killed by a cougar. FAW contacted the RP & provided advice/info on living with cougars & having livestock.
FAW rcvd. report of 2  cougars seen in the yard in Kayak Point. The RP's 5 year old saw the cougar. FAW Officer gave advice/info on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. RP saw a cougar with the goat in its mouth, after hearing the goat scream. The cougar dropped the goat & ran off after seeing the RP. The neighbors advised the cougar has a limp & has been spotted before. Houndsman were called but there was a time delay. RP was advised they could shoot the cougar to protect their personal property if it returned. FAW Officer gave advice/info. RP's were going to fix fencing.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting that was seen the previous day. Several people saw the cougar but did not report it. FAW Officer gave advice/info on cougars to the RP.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting on a trail camera. FAW Officer spoke with the RP & confirmed the photo of the cougar. The photo was captured a week prior to the report. FAW Officer gave advice, info & advised it was most likely following the deer into the orchard.

FAW rcvd. report of deceased deer parts on the RP's property. The RP believed it was due to a cougar. FAW Officer contacted the RP. FAW Officer searched the scene & found the stomach contents of the deer. It appeared to be a small fawn. The Officer determined it was most likely killed by coyotes not a cougar.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. FAW Officers rspd. & confirmed the goat had signs of a cougar depredation. There was a trail camera picture, most likely of a female cougar nearby. Houndsman rspd. & picked up a scent. A small cougar climbed a tree & jumped over a tall wall. After 2 hours they were UTL the cougar. A trap was set with the carcass. 2 days later a bobcat was caught but no cougar. It was released. The trap was left for 2 weeks with no success.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on 2 sheep. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene. The RP had removed the carcasses. In the AM of the 16th the RP saw 1 ewe not moving & found the 2nd one @ a cached site. The RP showed photos to the Officer of the sheep. The RP had a legal hunter on the property with no hounds. One permit was issued.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar tracks found over the summer near a sheep pen. The pen is enclosed with tall deer fencing. The RP thought @ first it may have been coyote tracks. FAW Officer contacted the RP & confirmed the RP had lost chickens to a coyote. RP also had 2 ram sheep that were missing since July. The tracks were no longer there & FAW was unable to confirm a cougar in the area.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting that was located at Brinnon School. FAW Officer rspd. & met with the RP. The RP heard cougar noises while it was still dark. The RP showed the Officer where the noises came from. FAW Officer checked the area & found elk tracks but no cougar sign. School Admins were given info & advice.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted behind a house. RP believed it was the large collared one that was @ the neighbors property recently. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info.
Citizen spotted a possible cougar in her backyard. WDFW officer responded and set up a game camera. WDFW officer was unable to confirm the sighting at this time.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in Dayton. RP saw the cougar while walking the dogs @ 2100 hours. The cougar was near the AG building next to the school. The dogs barked @ the cougar & it took off towards the river. The RP believes it was approx. 60lbs. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of someone shooting a cougar while it was taking a goat. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene. A 2nd goat had been take 2 nights prior to this incident. The cougar was shot @ approx. 2030 hours. After inspecting the goat carcass it was a confirmed cougar kill. The cougar carcass was inspected. The RP was a licensed cougar tag holder & was able to keep the cougar. Samples were taken from the carcass & it was sealed. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a dog. FAW contacted the RP. On 10/17 the RP left the dog secured to a chain outside while they were gone. When they returned they saw a cougar run from the area where the dog had been. The dog was deceased & cached. The dog was a 5 YO German Shepherd. Due to active hunting seasons, Hounsdmen were not an option. The RP was issued a kill permit. FAW Officer gave advice/info.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar taking a quartered out deer. The RP did not see the cougar but heard cougar sounds. FAW gave advice/info on cougars.
FAW rcvd. report of a cougar captured on a trail camera photo. FAW Officer contacted the RP & confirmed the sighting. FAW Officer gave advice/info on living with cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar was passing through the property while the RP was building a fence. The RP yelled @ it & scared it off. There had been previous sightings in the past on the property. FAW Officer gave advice/info. FAW confirmed footage of cougar.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar ran across the road & up into a tree. The RP was parked nearby. FAW rspd. to the area & no cougar was observed. The RP described the cougar as golden color, 3ft long with a long tail. FAW Officer gave advice.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar that had been spotted twice in a week. The RP last saw the cougar @ 1945 hours when feeding the horses they heard a growl. FAW Officer contacted the RP and provided advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sitting on a stump.  The RP heard the dogs barking & went outside to look. After the lights were on & the dogs barked, it was left the area. FAW Officer gave advice/info.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted multiple times in a neighborhood. A coyote was killed within the last week, which the RP believed was by a cougar. FAW gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar going into the brush @ 6AM. RP reported the sighting to a police officer on the area. It was described as small lab dog size, solid color & pointy ears. It was dark when the RP saw it & could not see a tail. FAW gave advice/info.
FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighting in the Centralia area. The cougar was spotted @ 11AM & observed for 5 minutes. It was in the brush area off of I5. FAW Officer gave the RP advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. A hole was dug underneath the fence, the goats rib cage had been fed on the carcass was left in the pasture. Neighbors have seen bears in the area. FAW advised to put a trail camera up. Officer rspd. to the area & examined the scene. The feeding characteristics matched with a cat. It appeared the cougar had been scared off while feeding. FAW Officer gave advice/info.
FAW rcvd. report of  a poss. cougar sighted on the shoulder of a road that went into the bushes.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP saw the cougar @ night, approx. 15 yards away. It ran near the RP's shop. The RP only wanted to report the sighting. Info/advice was given.
Citizen reported a possible cougar sighting near her residence a week prior also stating that a deputy saw it as well. DFW provided advice but was unable to confirm sighting.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. The goat had been missing, there was blood drag marks in the pen & over the fence. There had been 2 previous depredations @ the location over a couple months. Houndsman & FAW Officers rspd. the next day. A cougar was treed on the property to the west. The neighboring property did not want the cougar euthanized but gave permission for the staff to be there. The cougar was left alone. The RP was updated. Advice/info given.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting on Moon Rd & North of SR 260. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP had seen something in the field that appeared to be a cougar. When the RP turned around to look it was gone. FAW Officer gave advice.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene. A yearling ram had been killed in a fenced pasture &  a gut pile was all that was there. The RP had seen a cougar on their trail camera over the past few years. The camera was on trails about 80 yards from the residence. There were no photos of the gut pile. FAW Officer explained with time delay & under the circumstances it could not be confirmed a cougar was responsible. Advice/info given.
Property owner reported a possible cougar or bobcat attacking his dog causing injuries to the neck. DFW responded determining that it was not a cougar.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar that had been endangering livestock on the property. The RP showed the FAW Officer where cougar was attempting to get the chickens & where it was shot. The RP attempted to yell & scare the cougar before shooting it. The cougar was an adult female without cubs & was missing a lower K9 tooth.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar in an orchard. When the cougar saw the RP it took off into a draw & was stayed there. FAW Officer contacted the RP & the RP advised he just wanted to report the sighting. Advice given.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar spotted on a ring camera @ 1:45AM. FAW Officer confirmed the footage.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. The goat had been fed on & a cached sight was nearby. The RP reported the incident the following day & had disposed of the carcass. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The goat was approx. 40lbs, the stomach had not been fed on. FAW determined it was consistent with a cougar kill. FAW Officer gave advice/info on living with cougars.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar that had been sighted several times in the course of a few weeks. The cougar was most recently sighted 2 days ago with a dog in its mouth. FAW gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar incident with a horse that occurred on October 12th. The RP had seen a social media post that the horse had its legs torn up & was euthanized. The RP's friends 6 year old saw a cougar while feeding the horses that morning. FAW Officer spoke with the RP, owner & gathered the horse had ran into a fence after possibly seeing a cougar. Advice/info was provided.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in a driveway. There were tracks on the property. RP's neighbors had previously had a cougar on their property as well. FAW Officer gave advice/info on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. A game camera in the area had a photo of a cat on it. FAW Officer contacted the RP & the RP had observed the cougar from approx. 70ft away. The cougar walked into the bushes, had a long curled tail. RP expressed concern for the neighbors chickens. FAW Officer gave advice/info about cougars.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP saw 3 cougars on the property & the horse was gone. FAW Officer contacted the RP but was unable to reach.
FAW rcvd. 2nd hand report of a poss. cougar sighting in the area. The RP was informed by her neighbor that there was a cougar walking near the house. FAW Officer gave advice/info.
Property owner reported a possible cougar killing 14 of their ducks. DFW officer determined it was not a cougar that killed the ducks.

FAW rcvd. report of 2 lost goats, poss. due to a cougar. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene. A carcass was found a few days after it went missing but it was not reported. The 2nd goat then went missing over night. The carcass was in the pen, there were drag marks & cougar tracks. The goat had been consumed & cached. Houndsman arrived & removed one sub adult male cougar. The carcass was removed.
Citizen believes she heard a cougar screaming on her property. WDFW officers are unable to confirm the sighting at this time.

FAW rcvd. report of poss. 2 young cougars walking across a road near a residential home. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The cougars had long tails & were walking into the orchard. They did not show aggression. Info & advice was provided.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in a residential area. It was sighted later @ night & visibility was not clear.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in the trees. Chelan Co. Deputy rspd. & did not see anything in the area. FAW Officer attempted to contact the RP.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. Houndsman were called out but unsuccessful. Overnight the cougar took another goat. FAW Officer reviewed the trail camera photos & confirmed a cougar was feeding on the goats carcass. Houndsman treed a sub adult female cougar a short distance away. The cougar was dispatched & removed.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. The goat was missing & the owner believed a cougar was responsible. The next day another goat went missing, & was found 60 yards from the residence. The goat was cached. FAW Officer & Houndsman rspd. The carcass was tied to a tree & the cougar returned to feed. FAW Officer confirmed a cougar kill. Houndsman treed a large adult male cougar. It was dispatched & removed. FAW Officer gave advice/info.
FAW rcvd. a 2nd hand report of a poss. cougar sighting. There were 2 sightings in 24 hours. FAW Officer contacted the RP's & gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting near the Palisades Elementary School. The cougar was approx. 50-100 yards away. A deer carcass was found across the street & had been cached, believed due to a cougar. FAW Officer rspd. & spoke with the RP. The school was given advice & information. It was advised that adults should be outside while kids were playing, and to call back if it was seen again.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar in the city of Tonasket. FAW Officer rspd. the RP had seen the cougar in his yard when it ran past on the side of the fence & then growled. The RP's daughter had seen a cougar 2 days earlier near the creek & it was carrying a deer leg. FAW Officer & County searched the area but were UTL. The school district was advised.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. The RP saw the cougar & described it as smaller but was able to take a large goat. Houndsman were called. FAW Officer rspd. & checked the scene. Cougar tracks were located & the carcass had been moved by the RP. The Houndsman located the cougar & dispatched it. DNA/Tooth samples were collected.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in a residences back yard. FAW Officer rspd. to the area. The FAW Officer spotted the animal & it was identified as a house cat. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting @ a residence. FAW Officer contacted the RP the following day. The RP was going to walk the dog & observed a cougar approx. 20ft away in the backyard. The cougar was not aggressive or doing anything. A golf course attendee also observed the cougar earlier. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in a backyard. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP saw it pass through the yard & 2 weeks prior had seen another small cougar in the street. RP's neighbors have livestock. FAW Officer gave advice/info & advised to inform the neighbors.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar living on a property. The property was overgrown & was going to be getting cleared. FAW Officer contacted the RP. It was advised it possibly could be sitting on a deer kill. RP was going to clear the bushes to help. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on a sheep. FAW rspd. & Houndsman. A trail camera was set & caught a cougar feeding on the carcass. FAW Officer examined the carcass & observed bite marks around the neck & a broken neck. The collared cougar was dispatched & provided to the RP as a tag holder. FAW Officer took DNA & tooth samples.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar crossed the road in front of the RP. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The cougar was not aggressive & ran in the roadway. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar jumping from a tree into a yard. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The cougar was described as medium sized, dark in color & had a long tail. FAW Officer gave advice/info. RP was advised to call for any future sightings.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar depredation on a K-9. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The dog was barking @ the door & was let outside. The dog didn't return & was found deceased near the porch. There was puncture marks on the rear leg of the dog, puncturing the artery. The RP did not see the cougar but figured it was one due to the sightings in the area. FAW Officer provided advice/info to the RP.

FAW rcvd. report of poss. 2 cougar sightings. The cougar passed through the RP's yard on 2 occasions. The cat was described as large with a long tail. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info.

FAW Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. RP saw the cougar kill the goat, the goat carcass was examined. It had been cached against a fence line. The feeding patterns confirmed a cougar. Houndsman rspd. & a kill permit was issued. On 11/4 the cougar was dispatched & FAW Officer removed the cougar carcass & submitted DNA.
FAW rcvd. report of a cougar spotted on an outdoor camera. The cougar was caught walking in front of a house in the AM. FAW Officer reviewed the footage and confirmed it was a cougar.
Reporting party stated that their dog was killed by a possible cougar. DFW officer responded determining it was not a cougar that killed the dog.
FAW rcvd. report of a cougar crossing the road way in front of an RP's vehicle. The cougar was spotted @ 0540 hours.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar ran across a yard toward a river. FAW Officer. contacted the RP. There had been no other sightings since, in that area. The Wenatchee River is a common area for deer, coyotes & cougars. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting that had occurred the previous night. FAW Officer rspd. to the residence. The RP had observed 2 cougars walking the fence line @ the neighbors property, they were stalking the chickens. They were approx. 200 yards away. The cougars were described as tan with a long tail. FAW Officer observed the fence line & neighboring property. There were no tracks, the coop was secure & a guard dog was outside. Info/advice was given to the RP.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a chicken. Several chickens had been lost in the area according to the RP. FAW Officer contacted the RP & confirmed they had not lost any chickens but the neighbors had. The cougar had not been seen or caught on camera. FAW Officer gave advice/info on living with cougars & livestock.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting on a security camera. FAW Officer observed the footage & confirmed an adult sized cougar walked past the door in the dark. The footage was from 5-6 days prior to the report. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar sighted within 50ft of a home. There were deer under a tree that it was stalking. The RP shared with the neighborhood about the sighting. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The cougar was described as large with a long, black tipped tail. The cougar than ran away after the RP had seen it. FAW officer gave advice/info & suggested to pick up the apples to minimize the deer activity.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar in the area. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP expressed concern about a poss. cougar incident in the area regarding a horse. FAW Officer provided advice/info to the RP & clarified the horse injuries, were not verified as a cougar attack.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting & activity in the area. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP & others had seen the cougar in the area. FAW Officer provided advice/information regarding cougars. FAW Officer also explained cougars are expected to live in rural area where there are deer.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted in a residence back yard. RP's neighbor had seen one several days before as well. The RP was concerned about chickens. FAW Officer gave advice/info on living with cougars.

FA rcvd. report of a deer kill in a backyard, poss. due to a cougar. RP didn't think it was coyotes. FAW Officer spoke with RP & reviewed photos of the carcass. FAW Officer rspd. & examined the carcass. It was a fawn with claw marks on its body & had been suffocated. FAW Officer confirmed it was due to a cougar. RP set up trail camera. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar in the area. The cougar was frequently in the area & had been making noise @ night. The RP had only seen the long tail when it was spotted. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info & was given links to the WDFW website about cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar in the area for approx. 2 months. The RP also reported a cougar smell coming from the backyard. FAW Officer contacted the RP. FAW Officer provided advice/info on cougars & also provided Wildlife Conflict Specialist information.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP was bike riding when they spotted a young, skittish cougar. The cougar went back into the woods behind the Archer Range. The cougar did not show aggression. FAW gave advice/info on cougars.

Citizen saw a possible cougar walk across the street. Citizen described the animal as fawn color, long tail, and larger than a mastiff dog. WDFW officers are unable to confirm the sighting at this time.

FAW rcvd. report of an individual shooting 2 cougar kittens in order to protect livestock. The RP had been having a raccoon issue with the chickens & carried a firearm @ night. RP shot 2 cougar kittens that were @ the fence line of the chicken coop. FAW Officer rspd. the kittens were removed & the area was searched for a 3rd cougar but was UTL. FAW Officer gave advice/info.
RP rcvd. 2nd hand report of a cougar going through a backyard. FAW gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting near an Elderly Care Facility. The sighting occurred @ approx. 4AM. Later that day @ 10PM Officer rcvd. report of a 2nd sighting @ the same location. FAW Officer contacted the Facility the next AM. A Chehalis Officer had rspd. but was UTL any tracks. FAW Officer went to the scene & was UTL tracks except for vehicle tracks. FAW Officer gave advice/info on cougars & advised to call 911 if seen again.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar returning to the area after a previous incident. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The cougar had taken a goat 2 days prior & the cougar returned to feed on the carcass. The RP locked up the other livestock, Houndsman rspd. with Officers. A large adult male cougar was dispatched & removed. DNA samples were taken. The cougar was approx. 140lbs.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting near a residence. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP had seen a cougar three times in a month close to the residence. One sighting the RP, saw the cougar over the ledge in the yard. It was looking back @ the RP & was approx. 20ft away. The RP made noise & it walked through the yard. The area has a healthy deer & wildlife population. FAW Officer gave the RP advice/info.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting on a property near a chicken coop. FAW Officer contacted the RP. FAW Officer gave advice/info on cougars & living with livestock.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar making noises in the area. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP described a growling noise that occurred in the dark around 1AM & then saw the cougar when the neighbors porch light turned on. There were reports of a cougar in the area earlier. One Houndsman was issued a depredation permit for 2 weeks. This was a precaution due to the area close to the Town of Tonasket.

FAW rcvd. report of poss. cougar activity according to a social media group. The cougar was spotted twice in the same location. FAW Conflict Specialist & Officer contacted the RP. FAW Officer provided advice/info on cougars to the RP.

FAW rcvd. report of poss. cougar activity in the area. The cougar activity appeared to be on a bank in the area where fisherman tend to leave fish scraps. The cougar was reported sighted near the 9 Mile Falls Dam as well. FAW Officer contacted the RP & gave advice/info on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in Benton City. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP's security camera had captured footage they believed to be a cougar. The RP wanted to let WDFW know about the sighting. FAW Officer provided advice/info.

Citizen stated that she had seen a cougar walking on her easement road. Citizen described it as large, Siamese cat color, dark long tail, and stated it had cat-like gate. WDFW officers are unable to confirm the sighting at this time.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on 2 goats. FAW Officer contacted the RP & the neighbors. 1 sheep, 1 goat were found deceased overnight. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene, the carcasses had already been removed. There were cougar tracks in the area & bite marks were found in the neck of both animals. Houndsman rspd. FAW & Houndsman were UTL the cougar after several hours. Info/advice was provided.

FAW rcvd. report of several sightings of a cougar in a neighborhood. There also was a chicken & cat missing. FAW Officer contacted the RP. No carcasses were located, but several cats & a chicken were missing. FAW Officer gave advice/info on living in cougar territory.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a llama. FAW Officer rspd. to the area. The RP believed it was killed in the AM. After observing the llama it appeared to be 2-3 days old & had been scavenged on. The injuries were not due to a cougar. FAW Officers provided advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar seen @ the RP's neighbors house over the past few weeks. The RP had not seen it & the neighbors hadn't reported it. The RP shared information within the neighborhood about the sightings. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on 2 goats. RP informed the Officer that they lived in the woods & just wanted to make WDFW aware. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene.
