The Officer saw a small cougar jump the fence & observed the 2 deceased goats in a long pen. The Officer believed there was a female cougar with a yearling kitten. No visible tracks were found. A trail camera was set, advice/info was given. RP was going to fix fencing.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar was spotted 2 days earlier on the property. FAW Officer contacted the RP. Advice/info was provided on living with cougars & livestock.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a deer. FAW Officer contacted the RP. There was a deceased deer on the property that had been fed on. The RP also had a cat missing. FAW Officer rspd. to the area & confirmed the deer was killed due to a cougar. The carcass was removed. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a person possibly followed or charged by a cougar while on the Cherry Creek Falls trail. The RP was able to scare it off. FAW Officer attempted to contact the RP was unable to reach.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar was walking along the trail below Capitol Peak. RP wanted to let WDFW for information.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in the area. The RP found a cougar & the den while trimming trees. The cougar did not chase the RP but stalked the RP off the property. The den & cougar were in a forested area. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info on living with cougars, the Officer rspd. to the area & searched but found no cougar sign.

FAW Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar was spotted walking the property. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info. The cougars were most likely feeding on a kill in the area. It was advised to play a talk radio on the porch as a deterrent.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar growling & sighting. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP showed the Officer "ring camera" recordings. The sound was similar to a growl but there was a vehicle in the background each time the noise was made. The neighbor set up trail cameras & were going to adjust the "ring camera". FAW Officer provided advice/info.

FAW rcvd. a report of a poss. cougar depredation on 2 alpacas. The alpacas were seen alive the previous night. The property was heavily wooded. FAW Officer rspd. to the area. There was a punctures, lacerations & the stomach area was open. There were injuries on the front legs as well. Prints were located but unidentifiable. Houndsman removed a collared adult tom cougar that was close to the residence. The alpaca carcasses were removed.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar attacking a dog. FAW Officer contacted the RP who had not seen the cougar but a 2nd party had seen it. The small dog was let outside & something grabbed it. The animal ran down the street with the dog. The next AM the 2nd party contacted the Officer & Officers went to the scene. The animal was described as smaller than a German Shepherd & tan in color. Officers found prints in the area that matched a coyote. FAW Officers gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting near a residential area. The RP was working on property when a co worker ran into a den. The cougar followed the co worker, behaving curiously. FAW Officer attempted to contact the co worker & got no response.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP & neighbors had seen the cougar & heard a screaming sound over a video camera. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided cougar information.
Citizen reported the depredation of one of her alpacas. WDFW Conflict Specialist determined the cause of death was a cougar.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. goat attacked by a cougar. The incident occurred @ 12PM the previous night. The RP heard the goats making noises but did not see the cougar. FAW Officer contacted the RP. RP provided photos to the Officer of the injuries on the goat. FAW Officer determined it was most likely a coyote & not a cougar. FAW Officer went to the residence & searched the area. K9 tracks were located, no cougar sign was found. FAW Officer gave advice/info.
Citizen reported an animal that had killed their alpaca. WDFW conflict specialist and officer responded and confirmed that the injuries were compatible with a cougar kill.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting near a horse pen. The RP went into the house & upon returning it was gone. RP had other livestock as well. FAW Officer spoke with the RP & visited the site. The RP had seen it walking in the middle of the horse field where the horse were spread out. FAW Officer provided advice/info to the RP.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in a back yard. Houndsman rspd. to the area & were UTL. There was evidence of a domestic cat & a domestic cat was spotted by the Houndsman.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar was reported walking around Deer park & going into the woods. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The cougar was described as 3-5ft in length & had a long tail. Houndsman were on scene & determined it was a house cat.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP was walking on the property @ approx. 9AM when the cougar was sighted. The RP was able to observe it for approx. 30 seconds. The RP's neighbor informed them they had a picture of a cougar in the chicken coop & that it appeared to have a limp. FAW gave advice/info on living with cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. It was chasing a coyote. FAW Officer rspd. to the area. No signs of a cougar were observed in the area. There were coyote & raccoon tracks. FAW Officers gave advice/info to the RP's.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar eating a coyote out on a road. There were several chickens & goats that appeared to have been attacked in the neighborhood as well. FAW Officer contacted the RP. Info/advice was provided. One cougar had been removed in the area since the RP's sighting.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in the area near a residence. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP had seen the cougar a few times over several months. FAW Officer rspd. to the residence & searched the area. There was coyote, beaver & other animal sign but no cougar sign. FAW Officer gave advice/info.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar was described as 6ft long & tan in color. It was walking up a hill. FAW gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting that occurred @ approx. 09:30AM. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP saw it heading towards the neighbors deck area & then observed it later running up the hill. RP also believed other residence in the area had found tracks according to a social media page. FAW Officer provided advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar was running through a field near an intersection. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP did not think the cougar was acting aggressive. FAW Officer gave advice/info.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP found poss. cougar tracks. FAW Bio & Officer reviewed the photos of the track & determined it was K9, most likely a coyote.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar & cub that were walking on the resort grounds in the AM. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The Resort Shuttle Driver observed what they thought to be a cougar & cub walking near the boardwalk. No security cameras captured any images. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a deceased cougar out on the Crescent Lake Pheasant Release Site. FAW Officer rspd. the next AM & removed it. Officers performed a necropsy. It was a sub adult male that had been hit by a vehicle & traveled to the release site. It appeared to have been dispatched by a hunter as there was a bird shot to the head. DNA Samples & a tooth were taken.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP observed it walking along the fence line @ 0600hours in the AM. FAW gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. There had been a peacock & chickens missing in the area. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The child's bus driver had seen the cougar one morning in the driveway. RP was going to set trail cameras. FAW Officer gave advice/info to the RP & did not hear from the bus driver regarding the sighting.
FAW rcvd. an Anonymous report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar was sitting on the front deck of a house near the Lower Lake off of Olympic. The cougar had been around the area for several days.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting near the Beaver Lake Middle School. A student saw a cougar on the trail located behind the school. FAW Officer contacted the school & provided advice/info. FAW Officer rspd. to the school & spoke with the student. It was possible it was a coyote or bobcat. FAW Officer gave the student educational information.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP had heard screaming & had a prior possible sighting. RP saw a cat like animal in the spot light. FAW Officer gave advice/info.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting captured on a game camera. FAW Officer contacted the RP & verified the photo. RP wanted to report as information only. FAW gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of cougar depredation on a goat & another goat missing. FAW rspd. Examination of the carcass determined a cougar. No tracks were found & the other carcass was not located. It was determined the incident happened the night before. The area was not suitable to bring in hounds & a trap was unavailable. 1 Depredation Permit was issued for 10 days, for 1 cougar.

FAW rcvd. report of poss. cougar attacking a dog. FAW Officer rspd. to the location & spoke to the RP. The dog was a smaller dog & it survived the attack. There were wounds on the top of the head, chest & legs. The wounds were consistent with a coyote attack. The RP heard the dog in the driveway & saw a cougar standing over the top of it. It was described as light brown, long tail & larger than a Lab. Houndsman checked the area. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar tracks found in a barn. There was no livestock missing or anything injured. A hunter had also seen a cougar on nearby property a week earlier. FAW Officer contacted the RP & advised they would monitor the area. Info/advice was given on cougars.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in a vacant lot. The cougar growled @ the RP.

Property owner reported her mule/donkey being killed by what she believes was a cougar. DFW officer responded and determined based on the injuries that the mule was not killed by a cougar but most likely coyotes.
Citizen reporting spotting a cougar on top of his chicken coop. WDW officers confirmed the sighting.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP & a 2nd person were on the porch when they saw the cougar growl at them from the neighboring vacant lot. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The person was walking a pet early in the morning when the cougar was spotted. FAW Officer contacted the RP & gave advice/info about cougars. It was advised the Island had a large deer population as well.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in a back yard. The RP's son had seen two cougars in the morning that were chasing a domestic cat up a tree. FAW Officer contacted the RP & gave advice/info on living with cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The cougar had been sighted several times over the month on the property. RP had seen scratch marks on a tree as well. FAW Officer gave advice/info on living with cougars & livestock.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. There were tracks in the snow, showing possibly more than 1 cougar. FAW Officer contacted the RP. Several rabbits on the property had been killed, the RP believe a female cougar with young were passing through. FAW Officer gave advice/info on cougars.

FAW rcvd. 2nd hand report of a poss. cougar sighting while running. The runner screamed @ the cougar & it went away. FAW was unable to speak with the runner. The RP just wanted to advise FAW of the sighting.
Citizen reported having a cougar coming up on her porch frequently. Citizen had video footage of the animal. WDFW conflict specialist was able to confirm the sighting.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a sheep. The sheep had died either Tuesday night or Wednesday AM. The RP shot @ a poss. cougar going to feed on the carcass, but it did not return. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene. It appeared to be 2 cougars from the tracks. Lethal methods were not appropriate due the time delay. FAW Officer recommended for a bio to come out & collar/track the cougar for now. Info/advice given.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. The head & the carcass was missing, the RP found the stomach, some hair & entrails. FAW Officer rspd. The goat head & leg had been fed on by coyotes. Officer gave advice/info on protecting the goats & sheep.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar trying to get through a dog door. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP's dog door was damaged & believed a cougar was responsible. FAW Officer rspd. to the residence. The plastic trim was broken, the aluminum metal was peeled back and there was a small drop of blood. The RP also found a track in the snow. FAW Officer found nothing that pointed to a cougar. The RP informed the Officer there was a similar incident on a social media group. FAW Officer gave advice.

FAW rcvd. report of poss. cougar tracks sighted around a farm. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The previous night the dogs were barking & cows were making noise. The RP looked outside with a flash light but was unable to see anything. The next AM the RP founds tracks in the dirt. FAW Officer was UTL the tracks & the damage to the fence was not related. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar incident with a dog that occurred during the PM. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The dog later died from the injuries. 3 large dogs were injured during the incident. The vet believed it was a type of predator that caused the injuries. Due to timed delay, hounds or a trap were not advised. FAW Officers attempted to do a site visit the RP was unavailable. FAW Officers believe a cougar or cougars were responsible based off the info/circumstances provided.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sounds in the bushes. RP observed an approx. 200lb cougar with a long tail. FAW Officer contacted the RP & gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar near an apartment complex. RP believed the cougar was going for a small dog in the neighborhood. There were also large scratch marks near a door. FAW Officer attempted to contact the RP & then responded to the area. FAW Officers cleared the area. The RP's neighbor had seen the cougar chase the dog to the house & then scratch @ the floor mat since it couldn't get inside. FAW Officers provided advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting near the School District. The Cougar was sighted in the Elk Ridge Heights Community. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP's kid had seen the cougar in the back yard. The kid had seen an animal with a long tail running. FAW Officer gave advice/info. Another FAW Officer drove to the area but was UTL the cougar.

FAW rcvd. report of 3 poss. cougars sighted together in the area. They had long tails & were near the swamp. FAW Officer contacted the RP. When the RP took out the trash the previous night, they saw the cougars walk from the pond across the hwy towards an open field. The cougars were not threatening. FAW Officer rspd. to the area. Ducks were observed, a large den to either a fox or coyote was found. There was signs of human & domestic dogs. No cougar tracks were located.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP's neighbor had seen a cougar multiple times & there were deceased feral cats in the area. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on 3 goats. The RP saw the cougar dragging 1 got over the fence, the other 2 had been buried. The RP scared the cougar up a tree & shot @ it but missed.  FAW Officer rspd. a depredation permit was issued with assistance of a houndsman.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in a tree, in a backyard. FAW Officer contacted the RP. It was described as a 60lb animal that was grey in color & climbed into a tree. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. There had been domestic cats missing in the neighborhood & large eyes @ night were spotted. A bobcat had been seen in the area as well by neighbors. FAW gave advice/info on cougars & nuisance  wildlife.

FAW rcvd. report of a deer poss. killed by a cougar between the hours of 0200 & 0630. The deer carcass was approx. 100ft from a cabin. Most of the carcass was consumed. FAW Officer contacted the RP & advised the carcass could be removed. Info/advice provided.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar hit by a car near a residence home. The RP was concerned about an injured cougar in the area. 2 County Deputies rspd. to the scene. The cougar was barely alive upon arrival & was in the ditch. The cougar was dispatched & transported.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar encounter. The RP was walking on a trail & saw the cougar @ a close distance. It was described as 250lbs, 5ft long, long tail & tan in color. The cougar looked @ the RP & walked away. FAW Officer contacted the RP.
Citizen reported having horses attacked by a possible cougar. WDFW officers are unable to confirm the sighting at this time.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting & missing dog. The RP had lost 5 chickens within a month as well & the dog had been missing for a few days. FAW Officer contacted the RP. No sign of a cougar was located on the property. FAW Officer gave advice/info & advised for a houndsman to help search for the missing dog. The dog returned home after 4 days missing. No cougar.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. A snowplow driver saw an adult cougar & tracks in the snow. FAW Officer contacted the RP. 1 set of small cougar tracks were found. Info/advice was provided on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar walking across a front lawn @ approx. 10PM. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The RP found several tracks the next morning as well. FAW Officer gave advice/info on living with cougars.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted in the AM. It was traveling North towards Peshastin Pinnacles State Park. FAW Officer contacted RP & gave advice/info.
Citizen reported a possible cougar sighting on a trail stating that he may have seen the animals paw before it ran off. DFW officer was unable to confirm sighting but provided advice.

RP was walking and saw a large cat with a long tail rolling in the field. The cat then got up and walked away off towards the west. The RP said it was far enough away that her Australian Shepard did not respond. Was seen at 2:00pm.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar captured on camera in a driveway. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info on cougars.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. FAW Officer contacted the RP.  The goat carcass was cached with dead grass & sticks. FAW Officer rspd. to the area with a Conflict Specialist. There were cougar tracks in the snow. The front shoulders had been fed on, & determined a cougar kill. A depredation permit was issued to the owner with use of hounds. In the afternoon 1 cougar was lethally removed. Bios took tooth & DNA samples & the carcass was disposed.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a sheep. FAW Officer rspd. the carcass was in the corner of the pasture & had been fed on the inside of the rib cage. There were large cougar tracks around the carcass confirming a cougar kill. A trail camera was set on the carcass. Houndsman rspd. when the camera captured the cougar feeding. 1 cougar was treed nearby & dispatched. Tooth  & DNA samples were collected & the carcass was donated.

FAW rcvd. report of poss. cougar sightings. The RP saw 2 cougars in the afternoon, & shot @ both but missed. The RP advised the FAW Officer 1 cougar stalked their son a couple months back. Houndsman were called to haze the cougar for the next day. The hounds were UTL the cougar after 60-90 minutes. A trail camera was set. Info/advice provided.
RP called WSP to report what she believed was a cougar walking on the side of a freeway. DFW officer was unable to confirm.

RP reported a possible cougar sighting on his property. DFW officer was unable to make contact with the RP until a later time stating he would send in photos of the cougar to confirm it. The photos were never sent therefore the DFW officer was unable to confirm.
FAW rcvd. report of poss. cougar taking birds. FAW Officer contacted the RP & advised the prints were K9, most likely coyote.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted in a neighborhood. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info on cougars. RP was going to place cameras & signs in the area.
FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar in the area. There was a domestic cat missing & a cached deer on the property. FAW Officer contacted RP & provided advice/info.
RP reported her grandfather seeing a cougar in his headlights two nights prior to the call. Due to the delay in time the DFW officer was unable to confirm sighting and advice was given.

Property owner reported a deer carcass that had been killed approximately 100 feet from the residence. Property owner believes it was a cougar that killed the deer. DFW officer determined it was most likely killed by coyotes and not a cougar based on the injuries.
Property owner reported seeing multiple cougars in the neighborhood but it is unclear if they were seeing the same animal or multiple. DFW officer was unable to confirm if it was a cougar or not.
RP reported a possible cougar bait sight has been set up nearby her property. DFW was unable to confirm the site and provided advice and monitoring for now.
Property owner reported a possible cougar laying near her property line. DFW officer was unable to confirm the sighting.
Property owner reported her dog chasing after an unknown animal that she believes was a cougar based on the noise it was making. DFW officer was unable to confirm sighting.

Property owner reported his dog being attacked by a cougar that ran off. DFW officer was able to confirm tracks. The following day the cougar returned to feed on the dogs carcass and the property owner shot and euthanized the cougar. DFW was notified.
Citizen reported a possible cougar sighting in the area. WDFW officers are not able to confirm the sighting at this time.
RP reported a cougar following them on a trail, RP believes he may have injured the cougar. DFW officer confirmed sighting.
RP reported a cougar running through the property. DFW officer was unable to confirm sighting.
RP reported a possible cougar sighting on her property, her dogs alerted it to her. Property owner stated that she is pro wildlife and that it has already ran off. She was given advice.
Citizen reported seeing a cougar in the area. WDFW officers are not able to confirm the sighting at this time.

Property owner reported a possible cougar going after her dogs then climbing a nearby tree. DFW officer was able to verify cougar through its tracks. Advice was given and advised that it is unlikely the cougar would return after loosing a fight to her dogs.
RP reported a possible cougar sighting stating that she believes it killed a deer after she found a deer carcass nearby. DFW was unable to confirm sighting.
Property owner reported a cougar attempting to attack their beagle, the dog did not die. DFW officer was unable to confirm it was  cougar.
RP reported possibly seeing a cougar near her residence. DFW officer was unable to confirm sighting.
RP reported possibly seeing a cougar crossing the road. DFW officer was unable to confirm sighting.

RP reported a possible cougar running through her property. DFW officer was unable to confirm that it was a cougar but recognized it was a good habitat for a cougar. Permit was issued and DFW will follow up on it further.

Property owner reported walking her dog during the evening hours when she spotted what she believed was a cougar walking across her lawn. She said she scared it away with her flash light. DFW officer attempted to come investigate the tracks but the property owner declined. DFW officer was unable to confirm sighting.
Property owner reported possibly seeing a cougar on her property. DFW was unable to confirm sighing, advice and education where provided.

Property owner reported a possible cougar attacking her dog on her front porch killing it. DFW officer investigated finding cougar prints around the residence, and confirming that the wounds came from a cougar. DFW officer tracked, euthanized and removed the cougar.

RP reported his neighbors dog possibly being killed by a cougar. The neighbor did not wish to file a report but the neighbor stated that the cougar was gone and the dogs carcass had been removed. DFW officer was unable to confirm depredation.

Property owner reported seeing what she believed was a cougar standing on top of her shed stating it was larger than a racoon. DFW officer attempted to make contact with the RP and was unable to confirm the sighting.

FAW rcvd. report of poss.2 cougars sighted over the course of Summer through Fall. The RP last saw one on November 5th. RP believes the cougars were in the area due to neighbors feeding deer. FAW provided advice/info on cougars & feeding wildlife.

Property owner reported two cougars frequenting her property and killing her ducks. Property owner expressed concern for her goats as well. DFW officer trapped and removed one cougar but has yet o remove a possible second.

Citizen reported a cougar killing a deer on her property. Citizen did not see the incident but states that a neighbor did witness it. Citizen states she looked out her window and had seen the cougar feeding on the deceased deer carcass. WDFW officers are unable to confirm the sighting at this time.

RP reported a cougar running into her glass door. The property owner believed the cougar was after her domestic dog. DFW officer confirmed cougar tracks but they showed no evidence of the cougar running or bounding. He was unable to track the cougar and information and education was provided.

RP called reporting that she found what she believes were cougar tracks around her residence also stating that the animal got into her trash can. DFW officer was unable to confirm it was a cougar and notified the property owner that this is the behavior typically of domestic dogs not  COUGAR.

RP reported a possible cougar depredation on her llama. DFW officers responded but were unable to confirm that it was a cougar based on the carcass.DFW officers set up a game camera for further investigation.

RP reported a cougar coming into her residence. on 1/8/2020 a hound hunter removed the cougar via a permit. He notified DFW that a second cougar was there and was issued a second permit. On 1/9/2020 the second cougar was removed.

RP reported a cougar living under the deck of a nearby residence. DFW officer determined that the cougar had become habituated and decided that the best course of action was lethal removal. The cougar was removed.
RP reported a possible cougar attacking and killing his dog. DFW officer confirmed it was not a cougar depredation.

School custodian reported a possible cougar sighting near the campus at 4:00 am across the street potentially getting into a residents chicken coop. DFW officer was unable to confirm sighting and provided information and education.
Received reports of a possible cougar sighting in the neighborhood, DFW Officer was unable to confirm the sighting.
RP reported a cougar that killed his livestock and the property owner subsequently shot and killed the cougar out of defense. DFW officer confirms depredation.

Property owner reported a possible cougar killing her domestic cat. Caller stated that she found cougar tracks and blood in the snow on December 22nd but did not report this until December 31. Due to the time lapse DFW officer was unable to confirm if it was a cougar.

Citizen reported a cougar chasing his cattle on his property. When the cougar saw the property owner it was scared off and ran away. DFW officer confirmed sighting and provided the reporting party with advice and information.
RP reported seeing a cougar on her property three times this week. DFW officer was unable to confirm sighting.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar incident with a child. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The child reported they were skiing when they encountered 2 cougars & 1 attacked while skiing down the wrong path. The child's  parents  called Search & Rescue @ the time as they couldn't find him. FAW Officers worked with KITTCOMM, interviewed the child & parents. After further investigation it was determined a false report.

RP reported hearing what she believes was a cougar during the evening hours. Property owner stated that she believes her neighbor saw a cougar as well. No signs of a cougar around and DFW officer was unable to confirm sighting.
RP left a voicemail reporting a possible cougar sighting. Caller did not want a phone call back and only wanted to report the sighting. DFW officer was unable to confirm the sighting.
Citizen reported a possible cougar sighting near her property. DFW provided advice and education to the reporting party but was unable to confirm the sighting.

Citizen called WSP who forwarded the report to DFW of a possible cougar sighting. DFW officer contacted the reporting party and was unable to confirm that it was a cougar but provided information and advice to the property owner.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar next to a building that was running into a culvert. FAW Officers rspd. to the area. There had been 2 sightings within 2 days in the area. Officers located the collared cougar. When the cougar ran out of the culvert it was dispatched & removed. The cougar was returned to the University of Washington Cougar Research Team.

RP reported a "small" cougar sighting near the front of their residence. DFW officers responded finding no cougar but confirming tracks. The officer was unable to determine if they were old or new tracks.
RP reported a cougar sighting seeing it near his residence with a deer in its mouth. RP went outside and scared it away. DFW officer confirmed sighting an d provided education and advice.
Citizen called WSP that forwarded a report to DFW of a possible cougar sighting. Reporting party reported seeing it cross the road near her residence.
RP reported a cougar sighting stating the cat was approximately 9" in lengths with a tail as long as half its body. DFW officer confirmed sighting.
Citizen reported a sighing of a cougar crossing the road. DFW officer provided advise and advised the caller to call back if they saw it again.

RP reported catching a cougar and four cubs on her game camera near her residence. RP also stated that neighbors had reported sightings as well. DFW officer confirmed sighting and provided advice and information.

FAW rcvd. report of poss. cougar tracks in the snow @ a Cabin. FAW rspd. to the area & located 2 sets of cougar tracks that followed the river. FAW Officer checked the area & was UTL. FAW Officer gave advice/info.

RP reported hitting a cougar with her vehicle and then watching the cougar run off. DFW officer was unable to verify tracks due to them being snowed over. The officer patrolled the area and did not locate any injured animals. The report was documented as unconfirmed.

RP reported a cougar sighting near their residence as well as a cougar killing a deer on their property. DFW confirmed cougar sighting and gave advise. The cougar returned in the following days appearing on the residents game camera and killing a second deer.  A trap was set up at the location by a DFW officer.
Property owner reported a possible deer being killed by a cougar outside his residence. DFW officer responded and determined based on the wounds that t=it was not killed by a cougar.
DFW officer received a report of a possible cougar sighting near a dwelling. Photographs were taken and observed by both an officer and a conflict specialist confirming that they were deer tracks,

DFW Officer confirmed sighting of a reported cougar sighting near a residence. At the time there was one active depredation permit. Houndsman confirmed removing one cougar but stated that there was still a second.

Received multiple reports of a cougar sighting in the area as well as second hand information that a cougar may have attacked the rear end of a horse. DFW contacted all parties involved have yet to be able to confirm if it was a cougar.
Reporting party reported that a cougar has  been spotted in the area multiple times in the past two weeks stating that there have been multiple cats and dogs gone missing.

RP reported a cougar killing her llama. DFW officer responded and examined the carcass finding no evidence of a cougar depredation. The tracks surrounding the carcass and residence were dog tracks. The DFW officer set up atrial camera nd witness dogs consuming the llama carcass. no evidence of a cougar was found.
Property owner reported a possible cougar walking through her backyard stating that it was very small. DFW officer was unable to confirm sighting.

The trap was removed a few days later with no cougar. FAW officers provided advice/info.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar incident with a horse. FAW officer contacted the RP. The horse had scratches & marks across its body & the RP beleived it was a cougar but did not see it. FAW rspd. the horses injuries were not due to a cougar but from running into "T" post femcing.
Rcvd. report of poss. cougar sightings in the area. FAW conflict specialist contacted the RP & provided advice/info.

Property owner reported seeing a possible cougar cross the road near this location.
Rcvd. report of a cougar in a telephone pole with a kitten @ the bottom. The Fire Chief in the area rspd. & found no cougar but a domestic house cat @ the bottom of the pole.
Property owner reported a cougar possibly killing her llama. DFW officer confirmed depredation and attempted to track the cougar with hounds but was unsuccessful.
Property owner reported a cougar possibly killing multiple deer in the area. DFW does not track or remove cougar that are going after deer. They were provided advice from the DFW officer.
Property owner reported a cougar on the property. DFW officers responded, located cougar, and successfully humanely euthanized the cougar.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted on a residences property. No signs of a cougar were found in the area. Info/advice was provided.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted in the brush near the road. When the car got closer the cougar returned back into the brush. FAW officer provided advice/info.

Property owner reported a possible cougar killing an elk on his property. DFW officer responded and confirmed that it was a cougar that killed the elk. DFW advised the property owner that we do not take action when the cougar is doing what it is supposed to feeding on other wildlife. Advice and education were provided.
Property owner reported some type of predator killing their cat, they thought it could be a cougar. DFW officer was unable to confirm it was a cougar.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar spotted on a deck while the RP let the dogs out. RP slammed the door & the cougar took off. FAW gave advice/info.
Property owner reported a cougar on their property that "swiped"  at their dog but did not injure it. The cougar left the property after the owner yelled at it. Advice and education were provided.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a lamb. FAW officer contacted the RP. The lamb was found headless & the body fed upon. The feeding pattern was consistent with a large cat. Houndsman started following the trail until heavy rainfall/ weather went through the area and eliminated the scent. A trail camera was left @ the carcass site. The cougar (s) did not return. Info/advice provided.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat. FAW officer arrived on scene. The carcass was partially eaten & cached. The feeding pattern was consistent witha  cougar. Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar captured screaming, recorded from a house camera. The RP's neighbor had seen a cougar take a cat in the area. FAW gave advice/info.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar spotted twice over the weekend. RP beleived it was a juvenile. FAW officer contacted the RP. It was not agressive & just walking in the area. The large creek drainage behind the property is suitable habitat for bobcats/cougars. Info/advice was provided. Unconfirmed.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredtation on a goat. FAW officer contacted the RP. The carcass had been stripped of all the beat to teh bone with hair everywhere. It was advised most likely coyotes due to the review of the photos & the fencing. Info/advice was provided to the RP.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredatoon on a llama. RP advised it was a collared cougar. FAW officer rspd. to the area. The llama carcass was partially cached. The injuries were consistent with a cougar. Houndsman were called out & the collar tracked. Houndsman located and removed one cougar from the area DNA samples were taken and the carcass disposed of.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar growling @ 2 domestic cats. RP & FAW officer concluded it was most likely the 2 cats fighting as they were observed on camera running around.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on 2 chickens. FAW officer contacted the RP. The cougar was observed in a field with the chicken in it's mouth. Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted in the area. The RP's neighbor spotted a cougar in the yard approx. 30 yards from the house RP beleives there was an adult & juvenile cougar in the area. FAW officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info.

Rcvd report of a poss. cougar sighting. RP's neighbor had heard a cougar making noises in a nearby tree. There were no claw marks on the tree. The audio recording could not confirm if it was a cougar or not. FAW officer gave advice/info to RP.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a llama. The RP & RP's neighbor were attempting to remove the cougar as the RP couldn't make it back to the house. FAW officer & houndsman arrived. The kill was confirmed cougar. 1 adult collared female cougar was euthanized a short disatance away from the killsite. The carcass was donated to the Kalispel tribe.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a goat with the cougar still on the property. FAW officer rcontacted the RP. THe cougar was younger & underweight. FAW officer arrived on scene & reviewed the carcass. Info/advice was provided.

Rcvd. report of a cougar running outside of a gate to a driveway. The cougar made noise in the brush & then walked within 10ft of the RP walking a dog. The RP was able to scare it off. FAW officer provided advice/info.

Rcvd. report of 2, poss. 3 deceased alpacas due to a cougar. FAW Officer rspd. to the area. 2 alpacas had injuries consistent w/ cougar. 3rd alpaca was found cached & the cougar seen over it. Houndsman rspd. and treed 1 un-collared adult male. It was dispatched & DNA samples were taken.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted while the RP was letting dogs outside. RP advised it hissed & ran up the street. The neighbors had a sheep taken by a cougar last month as well. FAW officer contacted the RP & provied advice/info.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in the neighborhood. FAW officer attempted to contact the RP.
Rcvd. report of hearing cougar sounds from the night prior & a dog acting scared. FAW gave advice/info.

WDFW provided advice/info to the owner.

Rcvd. report of a missing goat poss. due to a cougar. The goat was approx. 90lbs. There were drag marks near the fence but no carcass. The goat had been missing for 24 + hours & due to time delay FAW was unable to do anything with the predator that could've been responsible. FAW Officer provided advice/info.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar taking a lamb. The RP's neighbor had seen a cougar a few days prior. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The lamb had gone missing two weeks prior & the cougar was spotted again. FAW provided advice/info on cougars & game cameras.

Poss. cougar depredation on sheep. RP spooked the cougar during the kill in the sheep pen. FAW Officer & Houndsman rspd. The carcass had partially been consumed & was in the corner of the pen. Rcvd. report of a large strange sound on top of a house roof. The RP did not see what it was but believes it may have been the cougar in the area. FAW gave advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP was walking the loop in the AM when they spotted a cougar @ the S Reed intersection. The cougar stopped, looked & walked away. FAW gave RP advice/info.
Rcvd report of a cougar being sighted & posted about on social media. FAW provided advice/info to RP.

Rcvd. report of a cougar running near the exit to the park. FAW Officer contacted the RP.

Rcvd. report of a cougar in a field stalking a couple kids. The grass was approx. 1- 1.5ft tall & it was approx. 30ft from where kids were playing. The cougar ran off into the trees. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a cougar sighting near a house. FAW Officer contacted the RP. The area was checked for cougar sign but UTL. Advice/info given.
Rcvd. report of poss. cougar depredation one 1 calf.  Houndsman were deployed. A 2nd calf was found but died of unknown causes. A cat was struck but got away & was not removed.
Rcvd report of a bobcat in a tree, mistaken as a raccoon. FAW provided advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar going after a house cat in a tree. FAW Officer checked the location. The scat & paw print do not appear to be from a cougar. Advice/info given.
Rcvd. report of poss. cougar sighted @ night while working outside. FAW provided advice/info on cougars.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar in the Finley area. FAW contacted the RP. RP saw a young cougar cross the road and walk down the bank of the canal. FAW looked around the area, was UTL.
Rcvd. report of a cougar spotted in the front yard while a resident was working outside. A neighbor caught it on camera a few weeks prior. FAW gave advice/info.
Rcvd. report of poss. cougar heard up in a tree. FAW contacted the RP. RP did not see the animal. FAW advised from descriptors it was possibly a raccoon. FAW gave advice/info.

Rcvd. report of an RP dispatching a cougar. While mowing the field, the RP's neighbor saw a cougar along the creek. The cougar later was in the brush by the creek. It was described as acting strangely. The cougar was near children playing & did not appear afraid of humans. The RP dispatched it & contacted FAW. FAW Officer examined the carcass & determined it was a subadult female, possibly close to a kill in the area.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar breaking a chain link dog kennel. RP did not see the cougar but found a track. A cougar had recently been seen in the neighborhood. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info.
Rcvd. report of poss. 3 cougars spotted in the area. FAW provided advice/info on cougars.

Rcvd. report of poss. cougar tracks & sightings in the area. FAW Officer contacted the RP. RP's children had seen a cougar a couple days prior. RP had a game camera set. Photos of the tracks were K9. FAW provided advice/info.

Rcvd. report of a deceased goat that was partially fed on due to a  cougar. FAW rspd. the injuries were consistent with a cougar kill. A game camera was set over the carcass. Houndsman rspd. with hounds & removed 1 sub adult female cougar the following day. DNA samples were taken and the cougar was donated.

Rcvd. report of a cougar in a backyard while people were playing in a pool & the dog outside. FAW were ENRT to the scene. Kitsap Co & Port Gamble officers arrived on scene first & did not locate the cougar.
Rcvd. report of poss. cougar in a green belt behind a residence. FAW Officer contacted the RP and provided advice.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar near a residence. RP was concerned about livestock in the area. A pursuit only permit was issued to push the cougar out of the area. Rcvd. report of seeing/ hearing poss. cougar. FAW contacted the RP & provided advice. Trail camera was placed on the main game trail.

Rcvd. report of poss. 2 cougar sighted near a residence. FAW Officer contacted the RP. Several chickens & a cat had been missing in the area over time. FAW confirmed with a photo, a juvenile cougar was spotted in a tree. Houndsman were called out to search the area. FAW Officer provided info/advice about cougars to residences in the area.
Rcvd. report of a small cougar caught on video walking through a residences yard. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info on cougars after confirming the  images.

Rcvd. report of a goat carcass, poss. due to a cougar depredation. FAW rspd. FAW Conflict Specialist & Houndsman located & dispatched one 5-6 year old Tom (male cougar) from the property the next day.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The cougar walked through a front yard. The cougar was scared off by the RP yelling at it. FAW Officer provided advice/info on cougars.

Rcvd. multiple reports of a cougar captured on camera in a field near a school. FAW Officer rspd. & confirmed footage of the cougar. There were reports of multiple house cats missing. FAW Officer gave advice/info to the RP's. FAW Officer drove & searched the area & found nothing unusual. It is expected they move through the plateau area. It did not display any actions indicating a public safety issue. Info/advice was provided.

Rcvd. report of a person spotting a small cougar while running on the Grand Ridge Trail. Described as long tail with a white tip and Labrador size. It was not aggressive & walked into the woods. Info/advice was provided.

Rcvd. report of a cougar inside a chicken coop. FAW & County rspd. to the scene. The Deputy dispatched the cougar @ arrival as the cougar was inside the chicken coop taking chickens. The cougar was a sub-adult (40-45lbs). DNA samples were taken. FWA Officer gave advice/info to the RP's.

Rcvd. report of a deceased calf, poss. due to a cougar. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene. A game camera was set & the area monitored. No predators were captured on the camera overnight. FAW provided advice/info.

FAW rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on 7-8 ducks & chickens. RP spotted a cougar the day before carrying an animal & chased the cougar off. Several chickens had been missing the few weeks prior. FAW Officer rspd. 1 trail camera was placed on the property. Info/advice given.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a  goat. FAW rspd. to the area. The goat was seen alive the previous night & found in the AM of a fenced field. The carcass had been cached & was fed on confirming a cougar kill. Houndsman rspd. the next morning. 1 depredation permit was issued. The next day the cougar was located & dispatched by the Houndsman 1.5 miles away from the kill area. The adult Tom cougar had taken 1 other goat.
Rcvd. report of poss. cougar depredation on a lamb. FAW conflict specialist & houndsman rspd. to the scene. Confirmed a cougar kill. 1 cougar was removed & transferred to a WDFW Biologist.

Rcvd. report of poss. 3 cougars sighted walking towards the canyon near the school. FAW contacted the RP. 2 workers observed a cougar with 2 kittens on the south hillside. FAW provided pamphlets & info/advice.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted within the area. FAW provided advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a poss. juvenile cougar spotted in the area & a missing dog. FAW Conflict Specialist contacted the RP & provided advice/info on cougars.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar approaching a resident on porch. WSP rspd. but was UNTL the cougar. FAW Officer contacted the RP.

Rcvd. report of poss. cougar depredation on 2 lambs. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene. The carcasses were drug a short distance in a pen. There were 2 cougar tracks. Both sheep had been bitten, 1 partially consumed. 1 permit was issued to remove the cougar. FAW gave advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a deceased deer in the middle of the road. A 2nd person saw a cougar on the deer earlier. There were marks on the deer's neck. FAW advised to remove the deer.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted in a pasture. The cougar had been sighted in a fenced back yard and the RP's dog was able to chase it off. FAW contacted the RP & provided advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a cougar walking on the park trail.
Poss. Cougar sighted along SR 12 & SR 123. FAW unable to reach RP to confirm.
Poss. cougar sighted behind a residence. FAW provided advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a calf. FAW officer contacted the RP. The carcass was cached in the timber.
Rcvd. report of a cow injured poss. by a wolf. FAW rspd. to the scene. The cow was injured but alive. The injuries were consistent with a wolf. The attempted depredation was confirmed wolf.

Rcvd. report of a cougar interaction. The cougar was collared & apart of the Kalispell Tribal study. Due to the cougars health & abnormal behavior causing a safety concern, Houndsman removed the cougar.
Rcvd. report of a cougar sighted & a deceased deer in the area. FAW recommended setting up a trail camera. The photos showed coyotes but no cougar. Info/advice was provided.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar spotted in the play area of a neighborhood. The cougar stopped 100ft away from the RP, stopped, turned around  & proceeded North. It was described as healthy, young & curious. Info/advice was provided.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar screaming & growing. RP advised there were tracks on the property & the dogs had been barking.  The RP did not see the cougar. FAW officer searched the area but was UTL tracks. Advice/info was provided.
Rcvd. report of multiple cougars sighted near a home. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation. A horse sustained injuries that consisted of 2 scratch marks. They did not appear to be a cougar but due to another cause/source. FAW Officer gave advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a large cat sighted in a residents back yard. FAW gave advice.
Rcvd. report of a cougar spotted on a game camera. RP advised it had been in the area over a week. FAW gave advice/info.

Rcvd. report of a group of campers being charged @ by a poss. cougar the previous night. FAW officer contacted the RP. The RP was sitting @ the campground & observed a cougar approx. 20 yards away, it ran towards the truck & into the campground. The 2nd RP fired shots into the ground scaring it off. RP then saw it again the next day. FAW Officer rspd. to the scene & did not see any cougar sign. The RP was given permission to fire @ it if it returned to the campground. Info/advice was provided.
Rcvd. report of a cougar spotted in a front yard. FAW gave advice/info on living with cougars & livestock.
Rcvd. report of a cougar sighted in a front yard. FAW officer contacted the RP. The RP advised it had been spotted several times throughout the month. Info/advice was given.
Rcvd. report of a cougar sighted on a residences property. RP heard the dog barking & saw a cougar sitting in a split tree. Poss. a juvenile based on size. FAW officer gave advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sitting outside approx. 20ft away from the outside play area. FAW officer provided/ advice info.

Rcvd. report of a cougar stalking cattle & an RP attempting to scare it off. FAW officer contacted the RP. The RP had observed the cougar the previous 4 nights watching the cattle near the corrals. While moving the cows, the cougar spooked them causing them to go through the fence & get loose. The cougar did not respond to warning shots & continued to be in the area while the RP was searching for the cows. 1 cougar depredation permit was issued to the RP. FAW officer gave advice/info.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted in a backyard. FAW officer & Ellensburg Police responded. The cougar was spooked by a dog, hit the fence & then climbed into a tree. Ellensburg Police confirmed a cougar but was UTL. FAW officer checked the area & advised neighbors. Info/advice was provided.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar or a raccoon in the bushes of a skate park. RP heard a growl but did not see the cougar. UNCONFIRMED.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar going after a dog. RP walked upon the scene & the cougar fled near an intersection. The dog was able to run off. FAW officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar outside of a residence. The Kalispel Tribe Biologist successfully GPS Collared one adult male cougar in the area later that morning.

Rcvd. report of a deceased goat & a cougar spotted running across the road. The cougar returned to the carcass & was euthanized. FAW Officer rspd. in between, 2 more cougars appeared, 1 was euthanized the other wounded. The carcass was almost fully consumed & consistent w/ a cougar kill. There were more than 1 set of tracks. After the 2nd & 3rd cougar were euthanized a 4th cougar appeared @ the carcass & was shot at. Houndsman rspd. & treed then dispatched the 1 injured cougar.

Rcvd. report of a cougar treed in a back yard. FAW officer & conflict specialist rspd. to the scene. The property had previous cougar depredations in the past. While ENRT the cougar ran towards the water. Kittitas Co. also responded. The cougar was a small sub adult. Houndsman rspd. with the hope to tree & remove the cougar. The scent was lost as the cougar most likely crossed the river.
Rcvd. report of a poss. young cougar making noise, climbing a tree and onto a roof. RP believes there were cougar cub tracks in the yard. FAW gave advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar spotted in the neighborhood. FAW gave advice/info.

Rcvd. report of a goat missing, poss. due to a cougar. The goat had gone missing over night in the pasture. RP did not see any area in the fence it could've escaped. RP had seen a few coyotes & saw a larger one in the pasture later on. FAW provided/advice info.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted on a camp property. A cougar was spotted running away in a field. Houndsman located cougar scat & tracked the cougar a safe distance away before losing the scent. FAW provided advice/info.

Rcvd. report of multiple cougar sightings within the neighborhood. FAW officer contacted the RP. The RP had observed a cougar near the playground area. The Kalispel Tribe research team was going to check the area to possibly collar and haze the cougar.

Rcvd. report of 2 goats poss. killed by a cougar. The goats were tied on a tree line the previous night. The RP's buried 1 carcass, the other was cached in the woods by the cougar. FAW Officer & the KBD's located 1 sub adult male & euthanized it. FAW gave advice/info.

Rcvd. report of 2 goats poss. killed by a cougar. The goats were tied on a tree line the previous night. The RP's buried 1 carcass, the other was cached in the woods by the cougar. FAW Officer & the KBD's located 1 sub adult male & euthanized it. FAW gave advice/info.
RP saw cougar on security camera and was concerned about mini horses.
Rcvd. report of poss. cougar sounds in the area that ended up being a barred owl. FAW Biologist provided advice/info to the RP
FAW rcvd. report of a cougar laying in a road near a residence home. There had been another report of a cougar in the area.

FAW rcvd. report of a cougar stepping up onto a porch and backed a dog into the corner. The RP's were able to let the dog inside. The cougar took off. It was described as a small, juvenile cougar. The Kalispel Research Team was in the area & responded to the scene.
FAW rcvd. report of a yearling cougar captured on camera that was trying to reach its paw into the chicken coop. FAW Officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in a driveway. FAW gave advice/info.

Rcvd. report of a cougar taking down a deer & a poss. altercation with a dog. It was unsure if the dogs injuries were due to a cougar or not. No cougar tracks or sign was located near the dog. The vet advised it most likely had been hit by a car or fell off a vehicle.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar running around in the area. FAW officer contacted the RP & provided advice, info.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The RP heard growling & snarling noises in the woods near a cabin. RP believed there were cougar tracks the next AM outside of a vehicle. FAW officer gave advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a cougar spotted in the driveway. FAW gave advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a cougar chasing a fawn near the water. FAW attempted to contact the RP. Unconfirmed sighting.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar in a residents backyard.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar altercation with a domestic dog. The RP was walking with the dog who was following a scent, the RP heard a scream & saw the cougar drop the dog, then run off. FAW officer contacted the RP. Info/advice was provided.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar crossing the street from one residence into the woods. FAW provided advice/info.

Rcvd. report of 2 poss. cougar  sightings. The cougar was crossing the road in Turnbull Park.  RP advised it was not agressive. RP witnessed the 2nd cougar sighting as is crossed Andrus rd. FAW officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a poss. injured cougar laying on a residences property. FAW conflict specialist rspd. to the area & removed the cougar & cached deer nearby. FAW gave advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a cougar running across the road near a wooded area.

Rcvd. report of 3 sheep lost over the past 3 weeks. RP believed it was due to a cougar. FAW officer contacted the RP. RP had experience cougar/livestock issues before. The sheep/goats were roaming free & the pen was not fenced. RP was going to set game cameras. No carcasses/signs were located. Advice/info was provided.
Citizen reported two sheep being killed by a possible cougar. WDFW investigated and confirmed it was a cougar kill. Citizen was issued a depredation permit and was able to kill the cougar.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar harassing/chasing livestock. The RP saw a cougar chasing a mule in the pasture. The RP was able to scare it off by shooting warning shots. FAW officer contacted the RP. Info/advice was provided.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar with a chicken in it's mouth. FAW provided advice/info.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar taking a domestic cat 20ft from a back porch. FAW officer rspd. to the area with houndsman. Houndsman located & treed the cougar. It was dispatched & removed. DNA samples were taken & the carcass was donated to the Kalispel tribe.
Rcvd. report of horses acting odd & poss. cougar tracks in a flower bed. FAW gave advice/info on living with cougars & livestock.
Rcvd. report of a poss. small cougar sighted in a neighbors yard twice. FAW gave advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a juvenile cougar running through a yard from the porch the previous night. There had been a past cougar sighting on the property a year ago. FAW officer gave advice/info.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation. A carcass was cached & the feeding pattern consistent with a cougar. The cougar returned per the trailcamera. Houndsman were called, hounds treed a sub adult male cougar quickly nearby. The cougar was euthanized & removed.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar attack on a small dog. The RP let the dog out around 10PM & heard a growl, followed by some commotion. RP saw the cougar running away with the dog in its mouth. The RP yelled @ the cougar which dropped the dog. The dog was euthanized.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar spotted in the area. RP advised it was spotted on the deck looking into the window @ 8:30PM. Info/advice was provided.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar walking across the road in down town Ocean Shores.

Rcvd. report of a domestic cat poss. killed by a cougar. The RP saw the cougar run through the yard and then found the cat carcass. FAW officer & houndsman rspd. to the scene. Due to the length of time & heat factors. The dogs were unable to strike a fresh scent on the cougar. FAW office gave the RP advice/ info on cougars in tthe area.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar enconter from the previous night. RP advised the cougar was approx. 40 yards away staring @ another person until a car drove by and scared it off. It was then spotted 10 minutes later near the driveway. FAW officer gave advice/ info. A local houndsman was issued a pursuit permit & haze out of the area.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted in the area & spooking cattle. The RP had observed the cougar running in front of them on Bald Ridge Road. The photo was to blurry for the officer to confirm. Info/advice was provided.

Rcvd. report of  a poss. cougar depredation on 2 sheep. 1 was killed on a Friday night & the other the next morning. The RP did not report it right away. The 1st carcass was burried & the 2nd put into a garbage bag. After inspection of the carcass it confrimed a cougrar kill. RP had heard the dog barking & then found the sheep but did not see the cougar.  A houndsman was contacted but there was a delayed response. Info/advice was provided/
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting walking  in the back parking lot of a hotel near the dunes.FAW officer attempted to contact the RP.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting near the footbridge. The RP was walking on the trail next to the river when they heard 2 cougars on the hillside. FAW officer contacted the RP & searched the area but was UTL any cougar sign.
Rcvd. 2nd hand report of a poss. cougar sighted on a Boeing Campus. FAW officer contacted the RP. Info/advice was provided.
Rcvd. 2nd hand report of a neighbor spotting a cougar in a yard the previous night. FAW conflict specialist contacted the RP & provided advice/info. Most likely a bobcat based off the area.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar deprdation on a lamb. FAW officer contacted the RP, 2 lambs had been killed since friday with the same injuries. The feeding pattern on the lambs were consistent with a cougar. FAW officers arrived @ the scene & viewed the carcasses. Houndsman were called but UTL the cougar. A trail camera was set next to the carcass. No cougar returned to the carcass. Info/advice was provided.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting on a residences property. FAW officer contacted the RP.  The property was surrounded by brush, game trails & 2 elk were observed while looking for cougar sign. FAW officer was UTL cougar sign however if there was one it was probably following game animals. RP advised it appeared small & was not agressive. Info/advice was provided.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted in a residences yard @ 3AM, caught on video. FAW officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info.

Rcvd. report of a cougar in a cows pasture. RP heard odd noises & went to check on the cows when a cougar sprang up out of the grass and ran off. It was in amongst several cattle. 1 hound permit was issued.
Rcvd. report of a cougar sighted on a residence's property. RP believed it injured one of the cows & neighbors dog. FAW provided advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted during early AM hours. RP heard dogs barking & a cougar. RP spotted an adult cougar with the flashlight. FAW officer gave advice/info.

Rcvd. report of an RP walking on a trail in the AM & spotting a cougar approx. 200 yards away. The RP advised it was on the trail near the parking lot entrance. It walked away after being sighted. FAW gave advice.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted in a back yard. The cougar was approx. 10 yards from the house laying down. It did not appear to be bothered by dogs barking & there was livestock on the property. The RP shot towards the cougar & scared it off, it ran towards the creek. FAW officer gave advice/info.

Rcvd. report of a small cougar running off the roadway.  FAW officer rspd. was UTL. FAW officer spoke with a resident in the area who advised the dogs had been barking all night. A set of cougar tracks were located in the area, the officer upon further inspection came across a cougar with kittens, finding the possible den site. FAW officers & conflict specialists came up with a plan to haze the cougars out of the area due to public risk.

Rcvd. report of a cougar in a yard with kids & pets around outside. Due to a recently expired pursuit in the same area, FAW officer & houndsman rspd. The cougar was still in the yard when houndsman arrived. It was dispatched & removed. The cougar was a juvenile in poor condition.
Rcvd. report of a poss. large cougar spotted on a porch. RP's neighbor also had seen one in the past. FAW gave advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a cougar walking through a property twwice the previous week. FAW officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a poss. juvenile cougar spotted in the are while the RP was walking a dog. FAW provided advice/info.

Rcvd. report of an RP seeing a cougar on a trail while riding bikes. RP the cougar took a couple steps toward the RP, the RP yelled @ it and it proceeded into the bushes near the river. FAW officer contacted the RP & reviewed the footage from a sighting the week prior. The officer confirmed it was a large Bobcat on the trail.

Rcvd. report of poss. 3 labs injured/killed by a cougar. 2 lamb's necks were bitten through & the other partitally consumed. RP removed the carcasses & cleaned the area. The RP did not see the cougar & advised FAW there was no cameras & the animals were not penned up @ night. FAW officer & conflict specialist provided advice/info & advised to not remove any evidence if future issues occur with a cougar.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a sheep. RP advised it was the neighbors sheep who were killed the day before.

Rcvd. report of poss. cougar depredation on a sheep. RP had 2 sheep killed the day prior. FAW officer contacted the RP. The sheep chest cavities had been opened up, the landowner had a high fence & the sheep were in the pasture when killed. FAW officer arrived @ the scene. No sheep wool was found. RP believed it was coyotes, the carcasses had been removed & the photos were unable to show any detail. Unconfirmed. Info/advice was provided.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted on a driveway camera. FAW officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info on cougars and livestock.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar spotted in a yard. The cougar was under a tree & ran off when it saw the RP. FAW officer provided advice/info on cougars.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on2 goats. The goats were found in an open pasture. FAW officers searched the area & found drags marks going to the fence. Based off the bite marks & scene it was confirmed a cougar kill. A trail camera was placed @ the kill site. FAW officer provided advice/info. The camera was checked the next day & only captured a coyote. A cougar trap was placed nearby.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar incident. FAW officer attempted to contact RP & was unable to reach.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a horse. The horse rcvd. an injury 2 days prior. It had small lacerations that met too a larger wound. FAW officer rspd. and concluded the injuries were not due to a cougar or animal but external environment such as fencing or a tree. FAW officer gave advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a sheep. FAW officer rspd. the carcass was examined. It appeared to be killed by a coyote or domestic dog. The carcass was removed & buried. Info/advice.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on several goats. 5 goats had been killed over the course of a week. FAW officer rspd. The carcasses & property were observed. Per the attack indicators on the recent carcass & the cougar sighted recently, 1 depredation permit was issued. FAW officer gave advice/info.

Rcvd. report of  2 sheep poss. due to a cougar. FAW officers rspd to the area & determined the evidence pointed towards a K9. 1 domestic K9 track was found near the kill site. KB dog's searched the area, no cougar or bear sign was detected. The carcass was removed. Info/advice given.
Rcvd. report of a poss. black collared cougar near the Northwood Store entrance of Mt. St Helens. It was observed walking up a cliff. FAW Biologist gave advice/info.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting in the RV park. A hiker was out with the dog in the early AM when they spotted a cougar crossing out in front. RP advised of a lot of deer in the area. FAW officer gave advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a cougar sighted in a yard hunting a rabbit. FAW officer confirmed sighting with a photo. Info/advice provided.

Rcvd. report of  a poss. cougar sighting on a ranch. The cougar walked in close proximity to the RP. The RP yelled & it ran away. It had been sighted earlier that day in a tree as well. FAW officer gave advice/info.

Rcvd. report of a poss. encounter with a cougar. The RP was out with alpacas when the dogs ran towards them. RP heard a screeching noise in the woods & believed it was a cougar. RP had lost several chickens previously & has seen a cougar in the past on the property. FAW officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info.
Property owner reported a cougar sighting while feeding their turkey. DFW officer provided advice.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a couple sheep. FAW officer contacted the RP. 1 sheep had been killed & fed on the previous night. There were bite, drag & feeding marks consistent with a cougar. Due to the timing & heat a Houndsman wouldn't be able to come out until the next AM. Houndsman located a scent from the carcass the next day. 1 sub adult male was treed & removed.
Rcvd. report of someone almost hitting a cougar with a vehicle near mile marker 330 on Sherman Pass. FAW gave advice/info.

Rcvd. report of a cougar sighted on a camera twice. The cougar was captured on camera getting into a fight with raccoons on top of a hot tub. The RP was aware of other sightings in the area. FAW officer contacted & gave advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar spotted in the bushes. The RP saw 2 orange glowing eyes & a tan body while using a flashlight. FAW gave advice/info on cougars.
Rcvd. report of  a poss. cougar sighted in the area. The RP believed it had been on their porch.  FAW officer offered advice/info on cougars.
Citizen reported a goat getting killed by a possible cougar. WDFW investigated and lethally removed the cougar.
Citizen reported a possible cougar going after their goats leaving one injured and one missing. WDFW officers investigated and are unable to confirm what could have been the cause at this time.

Rcvd. report of poss. cougar depredation on a cow calf. FAW officer rspd. to the scene. Due to feeding patterns on the carcass it was consistent with a bobcat or cougar. Houndsman arrived but were UTL any cat. Trail camera was set over carcass. Camera was checked the next day & found no activity. Carcass was removed.

Rcvd. report of a severely injured deer, poss. due to a cougar incident. FAW officer contacted the RP. The deer was in an orchard @ the time. Based off the descriptors, FAW officer determined it was not due to a cougar attack. Info/advice was provided.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. The 2nd hand report advised the officer someone was fishing at the Snake River & observed a cougar 100ft away, getting a drink. IT then ran off. FAW officer provided advice/info.

Rcvd. report of a poss. 10 cougars sighted near the river. FAW officer checked the area & was UTL any cougar or the RP. FAW officer was advised by 911 the RP had a history of mental health issues & this was most likely a false report.
DFW officer picked up a deceased cougar on the side of the road.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting & deer kill in a backyard. FAW officer contacted the RP. The RP heard a disturbance in the yard approx. 20 yards away from the window. The next day the RP found a consumed deer carcass. The RP did not clearly see a cougar only a silhouette of a animal running. FAW officer gave advice/info.
Property owner reported a cougar killing his alpaca. DFW officer responded confirming it was a cougar kill. The cougar was tracked and humanely euthanized.
Citizen reported a treed cougar on their property. The cougar moved on on its own. WDFW officers were able to confirm a cougar in the area.
Citizen reported a cougar sighting near this location and requested it be trapped. DFW officer provided her with education and advised her we do not relocate based on sightings only.
Property owner reported that they believed a cougar killed their ducks, DFW officer was unable to confirm.
Property owner reported a cougar killing their sheep. DFW officer confirmed depredation and provided advice.
Citizen reported a cougar sighting, Conflict specialist coordinated a houndmans for lethal removal.
Citizen reported a seeing a possible cougar on the hwy while driving stating that he almost hit it.
Property owner reported a cougar possibly killing their goat, DFW officer confirmed it was a cougar and attempted to track the cougar unsuccessfully due to the areas congestion.
Rcvd. report of poss. 3 cougars sighted on the property chasing a deer. FAW officer contacted the RP & provided advice/info.

Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar depredation on a sheep. FAW officer rspd. The RP had lost 8 sheep within 3-4 weeks. Some carcasses had been fed on & others not. A trail camera was placed on the property & the area searched for cougar. Houndsman rspd. the next AM & were UTL a scent. The camera captured no new photos of any predators. No carcasses were found, only parts. FAW officer provided advice/info & advised the RP to notify WDFW immediately. Unable to confirm what took the lambs.
Property owner reported seeing a cougar on his back porch taking a cat. Advice and education were provided.
Property owner reported that he believed a wolf killed his cow. DFW officer responded and concluded that a wolf, nor any other animal killed the cow and advised the property owner to consult a vet.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighting. FAW officer contacted the RP. The RP had seen the same cougar twice in the past week. FAW officer gave advice/info.
Property owner reported a cougar killing her baby goat, she shot the cougar in defense of her livestock. DFW officer responded and removed cougar carcass.
Citizen spotted a cougar in her goat pen. The cougar had one of the goats in it's mouth. Citizen shot the cougar. WDFW officer confirmed the cougar kill.
Property owner reported a cougar killing their goat. DFW officer responded and humanely euthanized the cougar and removed it.
Property owner reported a possible cougar sighting in their backyard. Advice and education provided.
Citizen reported hearing of a possible cougar sighting in the area. Citizen did not sight the animal. WDFW officers are unable to confirm the sighting at this time.
Property owner reported a cougar sighting and is concerned other neighbors may shoot it. DFW officers are aware and monitoring.
Citizen reported a cougar sighting at the admin building at WWU.

Rcvd. report of 3 goats poss. taken by a cougar. FAW conflict specialist confirmed the depredation as a cougar kill. Houndsman & conflict specialist treed & removed one adult female cougar. DNA samples were taken & the carcass donated to the Tribe.
Rcvd. report of a cougar or bobcat sighted in the area. RP believed it was a cougar due to cats missing in the area. FAW officer spoke with the RP & provided advice/info.
Rcvd. report of a poss. cougar sighted in the area. FAW officer searched the residents area & found no cougar sign. Info/advice was provided.
Citizen reported a cougar chasing a deer nearby. DFW officer provided advice.
Property owner reported a cougar killing several of his chickens and taking his cat, the property owner shot and killed the cougar while in his chicken coop.
Citizen reported a cougar sighting. Advice provided.
Citizen reported a cougar sighting at this location near the fire house. DFW officer confirmed sighting and provided advice.
